## File: audio-recorder/src/audio-recorder.html
```html
<mat-card class="dino-audio-recorder-card">
  <mat-card-header>
    <mat-card-title>{{'Record your Form'|transloco}}</mat-card-title>
    <mat-card-subtitle>{{'Dino AI will fill it for you'|transloco}}</mat-card-subtitle>
  </mat-card-header>
  <mat-card-content>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(blobUrl|async) === null">
      <h3>{{'Form Fields'|transloco}}</h3>
      <mat-list class="dino-form-fields-summary">
        <mat-list-item *ngFor="let item of formFields">
          <span
            matListItemTitle
            [matTooltip]="item.description"
            [ngClass]="item.description ? 'dino-with-description' : null"
            >{{item.label}}
            <mat-icon color="primary" *ngIf="item.description">info</mat-icon>
          </span>
        </mat-list-item>
      </mat-list>
    </ng-container>

    <div *ngIf="isRecording && (blobUrl|async) === null" class="dino-recording-time">
      <button mat-fab extended>
        {{(recordedTime|async) ?? '0:00'}}
        <mat-icon>timer</mat-icon>
      </button>
    </div>

    <audio
      *ngIf="!isRecording && mimetype().startsWith('audio') && (blobUrl|async) as sourceUrl"
      controls
      preload="metadata"
      autoplay
      class="dino-audio-element"
    >
      <source [src]="sourceUrl" type="audio/mp3" />
    </audio>

    <mat-icon class="pdf-icon" *ngIf="!isRecording && mimetype() === 'application/pdf'">
      picture_as_pdf
    </mat-icon>

    <img
      *ngIf="!isRecording && mimetype().startsWith('image')"
      class="preview-image"
      [src]="(blobUrl|async)"
    />

    <mat-form-field *ngIf="audioTranscription|async as transcription">
      <textarea rows="3" disabled="true" matInput [value]="transcription"></textarea>
    </mat-form-field>
  </mat-card-content>
  <mat-card-actions>
    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="primary"
      *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) === null"
      (click)="startRecording()"
    >
      {{'Record'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon>mic</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <span *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) === null"> &nbsp; {{'or'|transloco}} &nbsp; </span>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="primary"
      *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) === null"
      (click)="loadFile()"
    >
      {{'Upload a file'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon>upload</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      *ngIf="isRecording && (blobUrl|async) === null"
      (click)="stopRecording()"
    >
      {{'Stop Recording'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon>pause</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="warn"
      [disabled]="(isCommunicating|async) === true"
      *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) !== null"
      (click)="clearRecordedData()"
    >
      {{'Delete'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon>delete</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="accent"
      [disabled]="(isCommunicating|async) === true"
      *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) !== null"
      (click)="download()"
    >
      {{'Download'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon>download</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="primary"
      [disabled]="(isCommunicating|async) === true || (nss.isOnline$|async) === false"
      *ngIf="!isRecording && (blobUrl|async) !== null && (audioTranscription|async) === null"
      (click)="transcribe()"
    >
      {{'Transcribe'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon *ngIf="(isCommunicating|async) === false; else communicatingSpinner"
        >transcribe</mat-icon
      >
    </button>

    <button
      mat-fab
      extended
      color="primary"
      [disabled]="(isCommunicating|async) === true || (nss.isOnline$|async) === false"
      *ngIf="(audioTranscription|async) !== null"
      (click)="audioFormCompile()"
    >
      {{'Fill the Form'}}<mat-icon
        *ngIf="(isCommunicating|async) === false; else communicatingSpinner"
        >edit_note</mat-icon
      >
    </button>
  </mat-card-actions>

  <ng-template #communicatingSpinner>
    <mat-spinner
      matSuffix
      color="accent"
      class="dino-communicating-spinner"
      [strokeWidth]="4"
      [diameter]="24"
      mode="indeterminate"
    ></mat-spinner>
  </ng-template>
</mat-card>
```

```scss
dino-audio-recorder {
  .dino-audio-recorder-card {

      display: flex;
      flex: 1 0 auto;
      flex-flow: column;
    }

    .mat-mdc-card-content {
      min-height: 100px;
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: column wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      .dino-recording-time {
        .mat-mdc-extended-fab {
          font-size: 26px;
          background-color: transparent;
          color: rgba(var(--mat-sidenav-content-text-color));
        }
        opacity: 0.6;
      }
      .dino-audio-element {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
        width: 100%;
      }
      .mat-mdc-form-field {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      .dino-form-fields-summary {
        width: 100%;
        max-height: 200px;
        overflow-y: scroll;
      }
      .mat-mdc-list-item-title {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        &.dino-with-description {
          cursor: pointer;
        }
        .mat-icon {
          font-size: 18px;
          width: 18px;
          height: 18px;
          align-self: center;
          position: relative;
          bottom: 1px;
        }
      }
    }

    .mat-mdc-card-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      justify-content: space-around;
      .mat-mdc-fab {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
        margin: 2px;
        .dino-communicating-spinner {
          margin-right: 4px;
          height: 24px;
          width: 24px;
        }
      }
    }
    .pdf-icon {
      color: #444;
      font-size: 45px;
      width: 45px;
      height: 45px;
    }
    .preview-image {
      height: 200px;
      width: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: auto;
      margin: 15px;
    }
  }
}
```

## File: breadcrumbs/src/breadcrumbs.html
```html
<ng-container *ngIf="breadcrumbs|async as crumbs">
  <div class="dino-breadcrumbs-toolbar">
    <mat-toolbar class="dino-breadcrumbs">
      <ng-container *ngFor="let breadcrumb of crumbs; index as i; last as isLast">
        <span
          class="dino-breadcrumb-current-route"
          [class.dino-breadcrumb-history-link]="!isLast && breadcrumb?.url"
          (click)="crumbNavigate(breadcrumb.url)"
          >{{breadcrumb?.label|transloco}}</span
        >
        <ng-container *ngIf="breadcrumb">
          <ng-container *ngIf="breadcrumb.icon">
            <mat-icon
              *ngIf="!breadcrumb.svgIcon; else svgIconTemplate"
              class="dino-breadcrumb-icon"
              [class.dino-breadcrumb-history-link]="!isLast && breadcrumb?.url"
              (click)="crumbNavigate(breadcrumb.url)"
              >{{breadcrumb.icon}}</mat-icon
            >
            <ng-template #svgIconTemplate>
              <mat-icon
                class="dino-breadcrumb-icon"
                [class.dino-breadcrumb-history-link]="!isLast && breadcrumb?.url"
                (click)="crumbNavigate(breadcrumb.url)"
                svgIcon="{{breadcrumb.svgIcon ?? ''}}"
                >{{breadcrumb.icon}}</mat-icon
              >
            </ng-template>
          </ng-container>
          <ng-container *ngIf="!isLast">
            <mat-icon class="dino-breadcrumb-separator-icon">navigate_next</mat-icon>
          </ng-container>
        </ng-container>
      </ng-container>
    </mat-toolbar>
  </div>
</ng-container>
```

```scss
      align-self: center;
      &:not(:first-child) {
        margin-left: 10px;
        @media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
          margin-left: 5px;
        }
      }
      &.dino-breadcrumb-history-link {
        cursor: pointer;
        &:hover {
          opacity: 100%;
        }
      }
      transition: all ease-in-out 0.3;
      -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.3s;
    }
    @media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
      font-size: 12px;
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Represents a single List of Forms with the same Form Schema, or a generic/mixed Item
 */
export interface CollectItem {
  /**
   * The Item name identifier
   */
  name: string;

  /**
   * The Item label
   */
  label?: string;

  /**
   * The Item svg icon filename
   */
  icon?: string;

  /**
   * The svg icon, if present
   */
  svgIcon?: string;

  /**
   * The Item custom url
   */
  url?: string;

  /**
   * The Form Schema id
   */
  schemaId?: string;

  /**
   * If true, an Edit Icon will be displayed on the item
   */
  editable?: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, a Share Url icon will be displayed on the item
   */
  shareUrl?: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, a Map icon will be displayed on the item
   */
  hasLocation?: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, only one item with a given exact set of metrics can exist
   */
  unique?: boolean;
}
```

## File: collect/src/collect.html
```html
<div class="centered-tour-element" tourAnchor="collect"></div>
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="filterBar === true">
  <mat-form-field>
    <mat-label>{{ 'Filter' | transloco }}</mat-label>
    <input matInput [formControl]="filterCtrl" />
    <mat-icon matSuffix>filter_alt</mat-icon>
  </mat-form-field>
</ng-container>
<mat-grid-list
  class="dino-grid-list"
  [cols]="(breakpointObserver.small|async) ? columnsSmall : columnsLarge"
  gutterSize="2.5em"
  rowHeight="1:1"
>
  <ng-container *ngIf="items|async as collectItems">
    <div class="dino-no-items-message" *ngIf="collectItems.length <= 0">
      <h1>{{noItemsMessage|async}}</h1>
    </div>
    <ng-container *ngFor="let item of collectItems">
      <mat-grid-tile
        class="dino-grid-tile"
        [routerLink]="item.url? item.url : ['/' + getCollectType, item.schemaId ? item.schemaId : item.name]"
        [tourAnchor]="uiServiceConfig ? item.name : ''"
      >
        <div>
          <div class="dino-grid-feat-icons">
            <mat-icon
              color="primary"
              *ngIf="item.unique"
              [matTooltip]="'Unique: only one item with a given exact set of metrics can exist'|transloco"
              >fingerprint</mat-icon
            >
          </div>
          <div class="dino-grid-action-icons">
            <button
              *ngIf="(getCollectType === 'forms' ||  getCollectType === 'reports') && item.editable"
              mat-mini-fab
              color="primary"
              aria-label="Edit Schema"
              [matTooltip]="(getCollectType === 'reports' ? 'Edit Report Schema' : 'Edit Form Schema')|transloco"
              (click)="editSchema(item.schemaId); $event.stopPropagation();"
            >
              <mat-icon>create</mat-icon>
            </button>
            <button
              *ngIf="(getCollectType === 'forms' ||  getCollectType === 'reports') && item.editable"
              mat-mini-fab
              color="primary"
              aria-label="Delete Form Schema"
              [matTooltip]="(getCollectType === 'reports' ? 'Delete Report Schema' : 'Delete Form Schema')|transloco"
              (click)="openDeleteSchemaDialog(item.schemaId); $event.stopPropagation();"
            >
              <mat-icon>delete</mat-icon>
            </button>
            <button
              *ngIf="getCollectType === 'forms' && item.shareUrl"
              mat-mini-fab
              color="primary"
              aria-label="Share Url"
              [matTooltip]="'Share Public Url'|transloco"
              (click)="openShareUrlDialog(item.schemaId); $event.stopPropagation();"
            >
              <mat-icon>share</mat-icon>
            </button>
            <button
              *ngIf="getCollectType === 'forms' && item.hasLocation"
              mat-mini-fab
              color="primary"
              aria-label="View Map"
              [matTooltip]="'View Map'|transloco"
              (click)="viewMap(item.schemaId); $event.stopPropagation();"
            >
              <mat-icon>place</mat-icon>
            </button>
            <!-- Chat with your data -->
            <button
              *ngIf="getCollectType === 'forms'"
              mat-mini-fab
              color="primary"
              aria-label="Chat with your data"
              [matTooltip]="'Chat with your data'|transloco"
              (click)="viewDataChat(item.schemaId); $event.stopPropagation();"
            >
              <mat-icon>smart_toy</mat-icon>
            </button>
            <!-- // -->
          </div>
          <div class="title"></div>
          <div class="dino-grid-icon">
            <mat-icon class="dino-mat-icon" *ngIf="!item.svgIcon; else svgIconTemplate"
              >{{item.icon}}</mat-icon
            >
            <ng-template #svgIconTemplate>
              <mat-icon class="dino-mat-icon" svgIcon="{{item.svgIcon ?? ''}}"></mat-icon>
            </ng-template>
          </div>
          <div class="dino-grid-label">
            <ng-container *ngIf="item.label ; else itemName"
              >{{ item.label|transloco }}</ng-container
            >
            <ng-template #itemName>{{ item.name|transloco }}</ng-template>
          </div>
        </div>
      </mat-grid-tile>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
</mat-grid-list>

<dino-floating-button
  *ngIf="displayAddButton|async"
  buttonIcon="add"
  [tooltipMessage]="'Add New {{schema}} Schema'|transloco:{schema: getCollectType.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + getCollectType.slice(1)}"
  (click)="addSchema()"
></dino-floating-button>
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-collect {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .dino-grid-list {
    margin: auto;
    margin-bottom: 12vh;
    .dino-no-items-message {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      align-content: center;
      height: 85vh;
      opacity: 0.4;
    }
    .mat-grid-tile.dino-grid-tile {
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 2px solid mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
      .dino-grid-action-icons {
        display: flex;
        flex-flow: row wrap;
        justify-content: space-between;
        position: absolute;
        top: 3px;
        right: 3px;
        .mat-mdc-mini-fab.mat-mdc-button-base {
          margin-left: 5px;
          flex: 1 0 auto;
          opacity: 0.5;
          transition: all ease-in-out 0.3;
          -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.3s;
          @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
            max-width: 24px;
            max-height: 24px;
            .mat-icon {
              font-size: 16px;
              position: relative;
              top: 4px;
            }
          }
          cursor: pointer;
          &:hover {
            opacity: 1;
            background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500);
          }
        }

        flex-flow: row wrap;
        justify-content: space-between;
        position: absolute;

        left: 10px;

      .mat-grid-tile-content div:not(.dino-grid-action-icons) {
        outline: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-flow: column wrap;
        justify-content: center;

      transition: all ease-in-out 0.5;
      -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.3s;

      .dino-grid-icon {
        color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
        fill: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 100%;
        margin: auto;
        img {
          flex: 1 0 auto;

          margin: auto;

        .dino-mat-icon {

          height: auto;
          width: auto;
          &[data-mat-icon-type='svg'] {

            width: 36px;

      .dino-grid-label {
        color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);

      }
      &:hover {
```

```scss
@use 'sass:map';
@use '@angular/material';

@mixin _slide-toggle-checked($palette, $thumb-checked-hue) {
    &.mat-checked {
        // .mat-slide-toggle-thumb {
        //     background-color: material.get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
        // }
        /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of slide-toggle that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
        .mat-slide-toggle-bar {
            // Opacity is determined from the specs for the selection controls.
            // See: https://material.io/design/components/selection-controls.html#specs
            background-color: material.m2-get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue, 0.8);
        }

        .mat-ripple-element {
            // Set no opacity for the ripples because
            // the ripple opacity will be adjusted dynamically
            // based on the type of interaction with the slide-toggle (e.g. for hover, focus)
            background-color: material.m2-get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
        }
    }
}

@mixin slide-toggle-color($config-or-theme) {
    $config: material.m2-get-color-config($config-or-theme);
    $is-dark: map.get($config, is-dark);
    $primary: map.get($config, primary);
    $accent: map.get($config, accent);
    $warn: map.get($config, warn);
    $background: map.get($config, background);
    $foreground: map.get($config, foreground);

    // Color hues are based on the specs which briefly show the hues that are applied to a switch.
    // The 2018 specs no longer describe how dark switches should look like. Due to the lack of
    // information for dark themed switches, we partially keep the old behavior that is based on
    // the previous specifications. For the checked color we always use the `default` hue because
    // that follows MDC and also makes it easier for people to create a custom theme without needing
    // to specify each hue individually.
    $thumb-unchecked-hue: if($is-dark, 400, 50);
    $thumb-checked-hue: default;

    $bar-unchecked-color: material.m2-get-color-from-palette($accent);
    $ripple-unchecked-color: material.m2-get-color-from-palette($foreground, base);

    .mat-mdc-slide-toggle {
        @include _slide-toggle-checked($primary, $thumb-checked-hue);

        &.mat-primary {
            @include _slide-toggle-checked($primary, $thumb-checked-hue);
        }

        &.mat-warn {
            @include _slide-toggle-checked($warn, $thumb-checked-hue);
        }

        &:not(.mat-checked) .mat-ripple-element {
            // Set no opacity for the ripples because
            // the ripple opacity will be adjusted dynamically
            // based on the type of interaction with the slide-toggle (e.g. for hover, focus)

    .mat-slide-toggle-bar {
        background-color: $bar-unchecked-color;
    }
}
```

```scss
@use 'sass:map';
@use '@angular/material' as mat-theming;

@mixin tabs-color($config-or-theme) {
  $config: mat-theming.m2-get-color-config($config-or-theme);
  $primary: map.get($config, primary);
  $accent: map.get($config, accent);

  }
  /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of tabs that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
  .mat-tab-label,
  .mat-mdc-tab-link {
    color: mat-theming.m2-get-color-from-palette($foreground, text);
    /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of tabs that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
    &.mat-tab-disabled {
      color: mat-theming.m2-get-color-from-palette($foreground, disabled-text);
    }
  }
  /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of tabs that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
  .mat-tab-header-pagination-chevron {
    border-color: mat-theming.m2-get-color-from-palette($foreground, text);
  }
  /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of tabs that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
  .mat-tab-header-pagination-disabled .mat-tab-header-pagination-chevron {
    border-color: mat-theming.m2-get-color-from-palette($foreground, disabled-text);
  }

  // Remove header border when there is a background color
  .mat-mdc-tab-group[class*='mat-background-'] .mat-mdc-tab-header,
  .mat-mdc-tab-nav-bar[class*='mat-background-'] {
    border-bottom: none;
    border-top: none;
  }

  .mat-mdc-tab-group,

    $theme-colors: (
      primary: $primary,
      accent: $accent,
      warn: $warn,
    );

    @each $name, $color in $theme-colors {
      // Set the foreground color of the tabs
      &.mat-#{$name} {
        @include _mat-tab-label-focus($color);
        @include _mat-ink-bar($color);

        // Override ink bar when background color is the same

    }

    @each $name, $color in $theme-colors {
```

```scss
// Import Angular Material themings
@use '@angular/material';

// Import all the theming functionality.
@use '../components/button/button-theme';
@use '../components/card/card-theme';
@use '../components/cdk-drop-list/cdk-drop-list-theme';
@use '../components/checkbox/checkbox-theme';
@use '../components/chips/chips-theme';
@use '../components/datepicker/datepicker-theme';
@use '../components/form-field/form-field-theme';
@use '../components/paginator/paginator-theme';
@use '../components/select/select-theme';
@use '../components/sidenav/sidenav-theme';
@use '../components/slide-toggle/slide-toggle-theme';
@use '../components/table/table-theme';
@use '../components/tabs/tabs-theme';
@use '../components/dialog/dialog-theme';
@use '../components/grid/grid-theme';
@use '../components/icon/icon-theme';

// Create a theme.
@mixin material-theme($theme) {
    @include material.all-component-themes($theme);

    // Dino theming mixins
    @include button-theme.button-theme($theme);
    @include card-theme.card-theme($theme);
    @include cdk-drop-list-theme.cdk-drop-list-theme($theme);
    @include checkbox-theme.checkbox-theme($theme);
    @include chips-theme.chips-theme($theme);
    @include datepicker-theme.datepicker-theme($theme);
    @include form-field-theme.form-field-theme($theme);
    @include paginator-theme.paginator-theme($theme);
    @include select-theme.select-theme($theme);
    @include sidenav-theme.sidenav-theme($theme);
    @include slide-toggle-theme.slide-toggle-theme($theme);
    @include table-theme.table-theme($theme);
    @include tabs-theme.tabs-theme($theme);
    @include dialog-theme.dialog-theme($theme);
    @include grid-theme.grid-theme($theme);
    @include icon-theme.icon-theme($theme);
}
```

```scss
  @include pu.mat-css-dark-theme-global() {
    @include _mat-slide-toggle-checked-color($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
  }

  @include pu.mat-css-light-theme-global() {
    @include _mat-slide-toggle-checked-color($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
  }

}

@mixin _mat-slide-toggle-checked-color($palette, $thumb-checked-hue) {
  &.mat-checked {
    /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of slide-toggle that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
    .mat-slide-toggle-thumb {
      background-color: get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
    }
    /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of slide-toggle that may no longer apply for the MDC version.*/
    .mat-slide-toggle-bar {
      background-color: get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue, 0.54);
    }

    .mat-ripple-element {
      background-color: get-color-from-palette($palette, $thumb-checked-hue);
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="(form|async)">
  <ng-container *ngIf="metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async">
    <mat-stepper labelPosition="bottom" #stepper linear>
      <mat-step [completed]="isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async">
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{ 'FORM METRICS'|transloco }}</ng-template>

        <div class="dino-create-form-step-container">
          <dino-form-metric-selector
            [hasOptionalMetrics]="hasOptionalMetrics"
            [allowMetricCreationFor]="allowMetricCreationFor"
            [secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed]="secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed"
            [isRecordAudioEnabled]="(isRecordAudioEnabled | async) ?? false"
            (goToDataEvt)="goToDataStep(stepper)"
            (audioFormDataEvt)="updateFormData($event)"
          >
            <ng-content metric-selector-message select="[metric-selector-message]"></ng-content>
          </dino-form-metric-selector>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
      <mat-step
        [editable]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) "
        [completed]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) "
      >
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{ 'FORM DATA'|transloco }}</ng-template>
        <div>
          <button mat-icon-button matStepperPrevious aria-label="Previous step">
            <mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
        <dino-pipeline-stepper
          *ngIf="(formSchemaStatuses|async)?.length"
          [setStatuses]="formSchemaStatuses|async"
          [setCurrentFormStatus]="null"
          [setIsPipeline]="isPipeline|async"
        ></dino-pipeline-stepper>
        <div class="dino-create-form-step-container" tourAnchor="create-form">
          <ajf-form
            #formContainer
            [form]="(form|async)!"
            [saveDisabled]="(isSaveDisabled|async) === true"
            [topBar]="(isPipeline|async) === false"
            [maxColumns]="(breakpointObserver.extrasmall|async) === true ? 1 : maxColumns"
            [centeredFieldsContent]="centeredFieldsContent"
            (formAction)="onFormAction($event)"
          ></ajf-form>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
    </mat-stepper>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async) === false">
    <dino-pipeline-stepper
      *ngIf="(formSchemaStatuses|async)?.length"
      [setStatuses]="formSchemaStatuses|async"
      [setCurrentFormStatus]="null"
      [setIsPipeline]="isPipeline|async"
    ></dino-pipeline-stepper>
    <div class="dino-create-form-step-container">
      <ajf-form
        #formContainer
        [form]="(form|async)!"
        [saveDisabled]="(isSaveDisabled|async) === true"
        [topBar]="(isPipeline|async) === false"
        [maxColumns]="(breakpointObserver.extrasmall|async) === true ? 1 : maxColumns"
        [centeredFieldsContent]="centeredFieldsContent"
        (formAction)="onFormAction($event)"
      ></ajf-form>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(isLoading|async) === true">
    <mat-spinner class="dino-component-load-spinner" mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner>
  </ng-container>

  <dino-floating-button
    buttonIcon="save"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save form'|transloco"
    [tourAnchor]="uiServiceConfig ? 'save-form-floating-button' : ''"
    [buttonDisabled]="(isSaveDisabled|async) === true"
    (click)="saveForm()"
  ></dino-floating-button>

  <dino-floating-button
    *ngIf="allowSaveDraft"
    buttonIcon="save_as"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save draft'|transloco"
    [tourAnchor]="uiServiceConfig ? 'save-draft-floating-button' : ''"
    [buttonDisabled]="((isAjfFormValid|async) === true) || ((uniqueMetricsSetAlreadyExists|async) === true) || ((isLoading|async) === true) "
    (click)="saveDraft()"
  ></dino-floating-button>
</ng-container>
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-create-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  font-size: 110%;
  height: 100%;

  dino-breadcrumbs {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  mat-stepper {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
  }

  .mat-horizontal-stepper-content {
    height: 100%;
  }

  .mat-stepper-horizontal {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    .mat-horizontal-stepper-header-container {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .mat-horizontal-content-container {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
    }
  }

  .dino-create-form-step-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 85vh;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
      min-height: 75vh;
    }
  }

  .mat-stepper-horizontal {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-content .mat-stepper-previous {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-stepper-header-container {
    border-bottom: 1px solid mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100);
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-header {
      padding: 8px;
      flex-direction: row;
      flex: 1 0 50%;
      &::before,
      &::after {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      .mat-step-label {
        padding: 0px;
        padding-left: 5px;
        text-align: left;
        .mat-step-text-label {
          font-size: 16px;
        }
      }
      &[aria-selected='true'] {
        background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.3);
      }
    }
    .mat-stepper-horizontal-line {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-content-container {
    padding: 0px 4px 4px;
  }

  .ajf-form-container {
    .ajf-slider-container ajf-page-slider {
      max-height: 87.5%;
      overflow-y: scroll;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
        height: 97.5% !important;
        max-height: 97.5%;
      }
    }
    .ajf-slider-container .ajf-page-slider-content .ajf-page-slider-body .ajf-page-slider-item-content,
    .mat-toolbar-single-row {
      padding: 0px;
      height: auto;
      .ajf-left-bar {
        display: none;
      }
    }
    .ajf-page-slider-content {
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    .mat-toolbar {
      background: transparent;
      &:not(.ajf-toolbar) {
        .ajf-spacer {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      &.ajf-btn-strip {
        .mat-mdc-button.ajf-topbar-button {
          margin-right: 0px;
          background-color: transparent;
          color: rgba(120, 120, 120, 0.63);
          flex: 1 0 auto;
          transition: all ease-in-out 0.25s;
          -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.25s;
          &:hover {
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            color: #fff;
          }
        }
      }
      span {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        text-align: center;
      }
      &:not(.ajf-btn-strip, .ajf-toolbar) {
        display: flex;
        align-content: center;
        .mat-mdc-button {
          display: none;
        }
      }
    }
    .ajf-field-entry label {
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .ajf-form-page {

  .ajf-left-bar {

  .ajf-slider-container {

  .mat-mdc-card.ajf-field-entry {

          white-space: pre-line;
          max-width: 95%;
          overflow: auto;
          text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
      }

  }
}
```

## File: create-report/src/create-report.html
```html
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="(reportSchema|async)">
  <ng-container *ngIf="metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async">
    <mat-stepper labelPosition="bottom" #stepper linear>
      <ng-template matStepperIcon="done">
        <mat-icon>article</mat-icon>
      </ng-template>
      <mat-step [completed]="isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async">
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{'REPORT METRICS'|transloco}}</ng-template>

        <div class="dino-create-report-step-container">
          <dino-form-metric-selector
            [hasOptionalMetrics]="hasOptionalMetrics"
            [requiredMetrics]="requiredMetrics|async"
            [allowMetricCreationFor]="allowMetricCreationFor"
            [secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed]="secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed"
            [availableStatuses]="availableStatuses|async"
            [context]="'report'"
            (goToDataEvt)="goToDataStep(stepper)"
          >
            <ng-content metric-selector-message select="[metric-selector-message]"></ng-content>
          </dino-form-metric-selector>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
      <mat-step
        [stepControl]="dateIntervalForm"
        [editable]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async)"
        [completed]="isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async"
      >
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{'REPORT DATA'|transloco}}</ng-template>
        <div>
          <button mat-icon-button matStepperPrevious aria-label="Previous step">
            <mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="dino-create-report-step-container" tourAnchor="create-report">
          <p class="report-help">
            {{ 'Specify a date range to filter the data (optional).' | transloco }}
            {{ 'If specified, only forms completed with a creation date within the range will be included in the report.' | transloco }}<br/>
            {{ 'You can specify only one of the two extremes of the range, or neither.' | transloco }}
            {{ 'In the latter case, no filter will be applied to the completed forms based on the creation date.' | transloco }}
          </p>
          <form [formGroup]="dateIntervalForm" autocomplete="off">
            <mat-form-field class="dino-report-name-field" appearance="fill">
              <mat-label>{{'Report Name'|transloco}}</mat-label>
              <input matInput formControlName="name" />
            </mat-form-field>
            <mat-form-field class="dino-report-date-field" appearance="fill">
              <mat-label>{{'Collected Since'|transloco}}</mat-label>
              <input matInput [matDatepicker]="pickerFrom" [formControlName]="'date_start'" />
              <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerFrom"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
              <mat-datepicker #pickerFrom></mat-datepicker>
            </mat-form-field>
            <mat-form-field class="dino-report-date-field" appearance="fill">
              <mat-label>{{'Collected Until'|transloco}}</mat-label>
              <input matInput [matDatepicker]="pickerTo" [formControlName]="'date_end'" />
              <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerTo"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
              <mat-datepicker #pickerTo></mat-datepicker>
            </mat-form-field>
          </form>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
    </mat-stepper>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async) === false">
    <div class="dino-create-report-step-container">
      <form [formGroup]="dateIntervalForm" autocomplete="off">
        <mat-form-field appearance="fill">
          <mat-label>Data collected since</mat-label>
          <input matInput [matDatepicker]="pickerFrom" [formControlName]="'date_start'" />
          <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerFrom"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
          <mat-datepicker #pickerFrom></mat-datepicker>
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field appearance="fill">
          <mat-label>Data collected until</mat-label>
          <input matInput [matDatepicker]="pickerTo" [formControlName]="'date_end'" />
          <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerTo"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
          <mat-datepicker #pickerTo></mat-datepicker>
        </mat-form-field>
      </form>
    </div>
  </ng-container>

  <dino-floating-button
    buttonIcon="save"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save report'|transloco"
    [tourAnchor]="uiServiceConfig ? 'save-report-floating-button' : ''"
    [buttonDisabled]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) === false || !dateIntervalForm.valid"
    (click)="saveReport()"
  ></dino-floating-button>
</ng-container>
```

## File: create-report/src/create-report.scss
```scss
dino-create-report {
  font-size: 110%;

  .dino-create-report-step-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 85vh;
    flex-direction: column;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
      min-height: 75vh;
    }
  }

  form {
    .dino-report-name-field,
    .dino-report-date-field {
      margin-right: 10px;
    }
  }

  .mat-stepper-horizontal {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-content .mat-stepper-previous {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-stepper-header-container {
    border-bottom: 1px solid white;
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-header {
      padding: 8px;
      flex-direction: row;
      &::before,
      &::after {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      .mat-step-label {
        padding: 0px;
        padding-left: 5px;
      }
    }
    .mat-stepper-horizontal-line {
      visibility: hidden;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-content-container {
    padding: 0px 4px 4px;
    @media only screen and (max-height: 900px) {
      padding-bottom: 10vh;
    }
    @media only screen and (max-height: 580px) {
      padding-bottom: 30vh;
    }
  }
  .ajf-toolbar {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .report-help {
    margin-bottom: 50px;
    max-width: 70%;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
      margin-top: 30px;
      max-width: 95%;
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="qa">
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.question && !qa.noPrompt">
    <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-question">
      <mat-icon class="dino-datachat-entry-icon" color="accent">face</mat-icon>
      <span>{{qa.question}}</span>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.explanation">
    <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-response">
      <mat-icon class="dino-datachat-entry-icon" color="primary">smart_toy</mat-icon>
      <span><b *ngIf="!qa.noPrompt">Explanation:</b>{{qa.explanation}}</span>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.response">
    <div class="dino-datachat-response-container">
      <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-response">
        <mat-icon class="dino-datachat-entry-icon" color="primary">smart_toy</mat-icon>
        <span><b *ngIf="!qa.noPrompt">Answer:</b><span [innerHTML]="getFormattedResponse(qa)"></span></span>
        <div class="dino-datachat-sources-chips" *ngIf="getRelevantVectors(qa).length > 0">
          <span class="dino-datachat-sources-chips-span">{{'Sources'|transloco}}</span>
          <mat-chip color="primary" *ngFor="let vec of getRelevantVectors(qa)" (click)="openParagraphDialog(qa, vec)">
            <span>
              <b>{{vec.metadata.source ?? 'file'}}</b>
              <ng-container *ngIf="vec.metadata.page"> (pag.{{vec.metadata.page}})</ng-container>
            </span>
          </mat-chip>
        </div>
        <div class="dino-datachat-entry-follow-up" *ngIf="qa.followUpQuestions && qa.followUpQuestions.length > 0">
          <div class="dino-datachat-sources-chips">
            <span class="dino-datachat-sources-chips-span">{{'Suggested questions'|transloco}}</span>
            <mat-chip *ngFor="let question of qa.followUpQuestions" (click)="onFollowUpClick(question)">
              {{question}}
            </mat-chip>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="dino-datachat-feedback" *ngIf="qa.log_id">
        <button mat-icon-button (click)="onFeedbackClick(true)" matTooltip="Good response"
          [disabled]="qa.userIsHappy === true">
          <mat-icon [class.active-feedback]="qa.userIsHappy === true">thumb_up</mat-icon>
        </button>
        <button mat-icon-button (click)="onFeedbackClick(false)" matTooltip="Bad response"
          [disabled]="qa.userIsHappy === false">
          <mat-icon [class.active-feedback]="qa.userIsHappy === false">thumb_down</mat-icon>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.error">
    <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-error">
      <mat-icon class="dino-datachat-entry-icon" color="warn">error</mat-icon>
      <span><b *ngIf="!qa.noPrompt">Error:</b><span [innerHTML]="qa.error"></span></span>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.imageData">
    <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-image-response">
      <mat-icon class="dino-datachat-entry-icon" color="primary">smart_toy</mat-icon>
      <img [src]="qa.imageData" />
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="qa.componentData">
    <div class="dino-datachat-entry dino-datachat-entry-component-response">
      <ng-container *ngComponentOutlet="qa.componentData.component; inputs: qa.componentData.inputs"></ng-container>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
</ng-container>
```

## File: datachat/src/datachat-entry.scss
```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-datachat-entry {
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  max-width: 95%;
  width: 95%;

  .dino-datachat-entry {
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 10px;

    &:not(.dino-datachat-entry.dino-datachat-entry-component-response) {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
    }
  }

  .dino-datachat-response-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    /* Center align items vertically */
    width: 100%;

    .dino-datachat-entry.dino-datachat-entry-response {
      flex: 1;
      /* Take available space */
      max-width: fit-content;
    }

    .dino-datachat-feedback {
      margin-left: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      /* Horizontal alignment */
      /* Stack icons vertically or keep horizontal depending on preference, user said "besides(right)" */
      width: auto;
      margin-top: 0;

      button {
        margin-left: 5px;
        /* Add spacing between buttons */
        margin-bottom: 0px;
      }

      .active-feedback {
        color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100);
        animation: pop 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
      }
    }

    &.dino-datachat-entry-question {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(100, 0.2);
    }

    &.dino-datachat-entry-error {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-warn(100, 0.2);
    }

    &.dino-datachat-entry-response,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-component-response,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-image-response,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-image-error {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.2);
    }

    &.dino-datachat-entry-question,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-response,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-image-response,
    &.dino-datachat-entry-image-error {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;

      span,
      img {
        flex: 1 0 90%;
      }
    }

    &.dino-datachat-entry-image-response img {
      max-width: 700px;

      @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
        max-width: 90%;
      }
    }

    .dino-datachat-sources-chips {
      margin-top: 10px;

      .dino-datachat-sources-chips-span {
        margin-right: 10px;
      }

      .mat-mdc-chip {
        background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100, 0.4);
        margin-right: 5px;
        cursor: pointer;

        span {
          font-size: 12px;
          cursor: pointer;
        }
      }
    }

  }

  .dino-datachat-entry-icon {
    margin-right: 10px;
  }
}

@keyframes pop {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  50% {
    transform: scale(1.3);
  }

  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
```

```html
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>

<ng-container *ngIf="(noTokens|async) === false; else notokens">
  <ng-container *ngIf="(noData|async) === false; else nodata">
    <div class="dino-datachat-container">
      <ng-container *ngIf="(isLoading|async) === false; else loading">
        <ng-container *ngIf="!termsAccepted">
          <div class="dino-gpt-terms-container">
            <ng-content select="[gptTerms]"></ng-content>
          </div>

          <div class="dino-gpt-accept-box">
            <button mat-button color="primary" (click)="acceptTerms()" mat-raised-button>
              {{'Accept'|transloco}}
            </button>
          </div>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container [formGroup]="apiKeyFormGroup" *ngIf="(apiKey|async) === null && termsAccepted">
          <mat-form-field class="dino-apikey-field">
            <mat-label>{{'Enter your DataChat API key'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input [readonly]="(apiKey|async) !== null" #apiKeyInput matInput formControlName="apiKeyControl"
              (keyup.enter)="sendAPIKey(apiKeyInput.value)" type="password" />
            <button *ngIf="(isCommunicating|async) === false; else communicatingSpinner" mat-mini-fab matSuffix
              color="accent" aria-label="Send API Key" class="dino-apikey-field-fab"
              (click)="sendAPIKey(apiKeyInput.value)">
              <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
            </button>

            <ng-template #communicatingSpinner>
              <mat-spinner matSuffix class="dino-communicating-spinner" color="accent" [strokeWidth]="4" [diameter]="32"
                mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner>
            </ng-template>

            <mat-error *ngIf="apiKeyFormGroup.get('apiKeyControl')?.hasError('required')">
              API Key is <strong>required</strong>
            </mat-error>
            <mat-error *ngIf="apiKeyFormGroup.get('apiKeyControl')?.hasError('invalid')">
              Invalid API Key
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container *ngIf="(apiKey|async) !== null && termsAccepted">
          <ng-container *ngIf="termsAccepted">
            <div #chatHistory class="dino-chat-history-container">
              <dino-datachat-entry *ngFor="let qa of history" [qa]="qa" [bucketUrl]="bucketUrl"
                (followUpClick)="chat($event)"
                (feedbackClick)="sendFeedback($event.logId, $event.isPositive, $event.question, $event.answer)" />
            </div>
          </ng-container>

          <ng-container [formGroup]="chatInputFormGrop" *ngIf="termsAccepted">
            <div class="dino-chat-input-container">
              <mat-form-field appearance="fill" class="dino-chat-namespace-select" *ngIf="mode === 'completion'">
                <mat-label>{{'Namespace'|transloco}}</mat-label>
                <mat-select #namespace (selectionChange)="selectNamespace($event)"
                  [(value)]="currentNamespace"><mat-option *ngFor="let namespace of namespaces" [value]="namespace">
                    {{namespace || 'default'}}
                  </mat-option></mat-select></mat-form-field>
              <mat-form-field class="dino-chat-text-input">
                <textarea #chatPrompt matInput formControlName="chatInputControl" rows="1" cols="50" placeholder="Ciao!"
                  style="resize: none;" (keydown)="chatPromptText = chatPrompt.value"
                  (keyup.enter)="chat(chatPromptText); chatPrompt.value = ''; chatPromptText = '';"></textarea>
              </mat-form-field>
            </div>
          </ng-container>
        </ng-container>
      </ng-container>

      <ng-template #loading>
        <div class="dino-loading">
          <ng-container *ngIf="spinnerImagePath; else defaultspinner"><dino-loading-spinner
              [spinnerImagePath]="spinnerImagePath"></dino-loading-spinner>
          </ng-container>
          <ng-template #defaultspinner><mat-spinner class="dino-component-load-spinner"
              mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner></ng-template>
        </div>
      </ng-template>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
</ng-container>

<ng-template #nodata>
  <div class="dino-no-items-message">
    <h1>{{'No Forms were found'|transloco}}</h1>
  </div>
</ng-template>

<ng-template #notokens>
  <div class="dino-no-tokens-message">
    <h1 class="dino-no-tokens-message-row">
      {{'Sorry, you don\'t have enough Credits!'|transloco}}
    </h1>
    <br />
    <h1 *ngIf="config" class="dino-no-tokens-message-row dino-no-tokens-message-row-buy" (click)="openPayment()">
      {{'You can purchase more Credits here'|transloco}}
      <mat-icon class="dino-no-tokens-icon" color="primary">smart_toy</mat-icon>
    </h1>
  </div>
</ng-template>
```

```typescript
export interface DataChatQA {
  question?: string;
  response?: string; // answer
  componentData?: ComponentData;
  imageData?: string;
  error?: string;
  explanation?: string;
  noPrompt?: boolean;
  namespace?: string;
  vectors?: CompletionVector[];
  userIsHappy?: boolean;
  followUpQuestions?: string[];
  log_id?: string;
}
⋮----
response?: string; // answer
⋮----
export interface ComponentData {
  component: any;
  inputs?: {[key: string]: any};
}
⋮----
export interface CompletionRequest {
  dinoGraphql: string;
  authToken: string;
  username: string;
  namespace: string;
  info: string[];
  chat: string[];
}
⋮----
export interface CompletionResponse {
  error?: string;
  answer?: string;
  vectors?: CompletionVector[];
  follow_ups?: string[];
  log_id?: string;
}
⋮----
export interface QA extends CompletionResponse {
  question: string;
  namespace: string;
  userIsHappy?: boolean;
}
⋮----
export interface CompletionVector {
  similarity: number;
  metadata: VectorMetadata;
}
⋮----
export interface VectorMetadata {
  text: string;
  mimetype?: Mimetype[] | Mimetype;
  page?: number;
  source?: string; // name of the file
  url?: string;
  image_url?: string; // a pdf (with a given url) might also contain an image
  start_time?: number;
  token_count?: number;
}
⋮----
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-datachat {
  .dino-datachat-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    .dino-apikey-field {
      flex: 1 0 auto;
      min-width: 300px;
      position: relative;
      top: 30vh;
      .dino-apikey-field-fab {
        right: 10px;
        max-width: 32px;
        max-height: 32px;
      }
    }

    .dino-chat-history-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: column;
      flex: 1 0 auto;
      width: 85vw;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
        width: 95vw;
      }
      padding: 6px;
      height: 74vh;
      max-height: 74vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border-radius: 4px;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      background-color: var(--mdc-filled-text-field-container-color);
    }
    .dino-chat-input-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 80px;
      width: 86vw;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
        width: 100vw;
      }
      .dino-chat-text-input {
        flex: 1 0 85%;
        @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
          flex: 1 0 auto;
        }
      }
      .dino-chat-namespace-select {
        flex: 1 0 15%;
      }
    }
    .dino-communicating-spinner {
      position: relative;
      right: 10px;
    }
  }
  .dino-no-items-message {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    align-content: center;
    height: 85vh;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  .dino-no-tokens-message {
    position: relative;
    top: 30%;
    text-align: center;
    margin: auto;
    opacity: 0.6;
    .dino-no-tokens-message-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      .dino-no-tokens-icon {
        margin-left: 10px;
      }
      &.dino-no-tokens-message-row-buy {
        cursor: pointer;
        color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
      }
    }
  }

  .dino-gpt-terms-container {
    max-height: 70vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .dino-gpt-accept-box {
    margin-top: 40px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .dino-loading {
    position: unset !important;
    width: unset !important;
    left: unset !important;
  }
}
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="metadata">
  <mat-card class="dino-paragraph-card">
    <mat-card-header>
      <mat-card-subtitle *ngIf="metadata.page">Pag. {{metadata.page}}</mat-card-subtitle>
      <mat-card-title>{{metadata.source ?? 'file'}}</mat-card-title>
    </mat-card-header>
    <mat-card-content>
      <div *ngIf="mimetype.startsWith('audio')">
        <audio (loadedmetadata)="onPlayerLoaded($event)" controls>
          <source [src]="metadata.url" [type]="mimetype"/>
        </audio>
      </div>
      <div *ngIf="mimetype.startsWith('video')">
        <video (loadedmetadata)="onPlayerLoaded($event)" controls>
          <source [src]="metadata.url" [type]="mimetype"/>
        </video>
      </div>
      <div [innerHTML]="metadata.text"></div>
      <img class="dino-paragraph-card-image"
        *ngIf="metadata.image_url"
        [src]="metadata.image_url"
      />
    </mat-card-content>
    <mat-card-actions>
      <a *ngIf="metadata.url" [href]="metadata.url" target="_blank">
        <button mat-mini-fab color="primary">
          <mat-icon>download</mat-icon>
        </button>
      </a>
      <button mat-mini-fab (click)="closeDialog()">
        <mat-icon>close</mat-icon>
      </button>
    </mat-card-actions>
  </mat-card>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="(form|async)">
  <ng-container *ngIf="metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async">
    <mat-stepper labelPosition="bottom" #stepper linear>
      <mat-step [completed]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) || (isView|async)">
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{ 'FORM METRICS'|transloco }}</ng-template>
        <div class="dino-edit-form-step-container">
          <dino-form-metric-selector
            [hasOptionalMetrics]="hasOptionalMetrics"
            [allowMetricCreationFor]="allowMetricCreationFor"
            [secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed]="secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed"
            (goToDataEvt)="goToDataStep(stepper)"
          >
            <ng-content metric-selector-message select="[metric-selector-message]"></ng-content>
          </dino-form-metric-selector>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
      <mat-step
        [editable]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) || (isView|async)"
        [completed]="(isFormMetricsSelectorValid|async) || (isView|async)"
      >
        <ng-template matStepLabel>{{ 'FORM DATA'|transloco }}</ng-template>
        <div>
          <button mat-icon-button matStepperPrevious aria-label="Previous step">
            <mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
        <dino-pipeline-stepper
          *ngIf="(formSchemaStatuses|async)?.length"
          [setStatuses]="formSchemaStatuses|async"
          [ajfFormRenderer]="formRenderer"
          [slides]="slides|async"
          [setCurrentFormStatus]="formDataStatus|async"
          [setIsPipeline]="isPipeline|async"
          (position)="scrollToSlide($event)"
        ></dino-pipeline-stepper>
        <div class="dino-edit-form-step-container">
          <ajf-form
            #ajfFormRenderer
            [form]="(form|async)!"
            [saveDisabled]="((isView|async) === true) || ((isSaveDisabled|async) === true)"
            [topBar]="(isPipeline|async) === false"
            (formAction)="onFormAction($event)"
            [readonly]="isView|async"
            [maxColumns]="(breakpointObserver.extrasmall|async) === true ? 1 : maxColumns"
            [centeredFieldsContent]="centeredFieldsContent"
          ></ajf-form>
        </div>
      </mat-step>
    </mat-stepper>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async) === false">
    <dino-pipeline-stepper
      *ngIf="(formSchemaStatuses|async)?.length"
      [setStatuses]="formSchemaStatuses|async"
      [ajfFormRenderer]="formRenderer"
      [slides]="slides|async"
      [setCurrentFormStatus]="formDataStatus|async"
      [setIsPipeline]="isPipeline|async"
      (position)="scrollToSlide($event)"
    ></dino-pipeline-stepper>
    <div class="dino-edit-form-step-container">
      <ajf-form
        #ajfFormRenderer
        [form]="(form|async)!"
        [saveDisabled]="((isView|async) === true) || ((isSaveDisabled|async) === true)"
        [topBar]="(isPipeline|async) === false"
        (formAction)="onFormAction($event)"
        [readonly]="isView|async"
        [maxColumns]="(breakpointObserver.extrasmall|async) === true ? 1 : maxColumns"
        [centeredFieldsContent]="centeredFieldsContent"
      ></ajf-form>
    </div>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(isLoading|async) === true">
    <mat-spinner class="dino-component-load-spinner" mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner>
  </ng-container>

  <dino-floating-button
    *ngIf="(isView|async) !== true"
    buttonIcon="save"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save form'|transloco"
    [buttonDisabled]="(isSaveDisabled|async) === true"
    (click)="saveForm()"
  ></dino-floating-button>

  <dino-floating-button
    *ngIf="(isView|async) !== true && allowSaveDraft"
    buttonIcon="save_as"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save draft'|transloco"
    [buttonDisabled]="((isAjfFormValid|async) === true) || ((uniqueMetricsSetAlreadyExists|async) === true) || ((isLoading|async) === true)"
    (click)="saveDraft()"
  ></dino-floating-button>
</ng-container>
```

## File: edit-form-schema/src/edit-form-schema.html
```html
<ng-container *ngIf="form|async as form">
  <mat-card appearance="outlined" class="form-container">
    <ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
    <mat-card-content>
      <div class="card-header" *ngIf="formGroup|async as fgroup">
        <form [formGroup]="fgroup" class="dino-form-attributes">
          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Form Name'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input matInput formControlName="name" />
            <mat-error *ngIf="fgroup.controls['name'].hasError('incorrect')">
              {{ 'This name is already being used.'|transloco}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>
          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Form Label'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <b><input matInput formControlName="label" /></b>
          </mat-form-field>
          <mat-form-field class="dino-form-attribute-short-field">
            <mat-label>{{'Icon Set'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select #iconSetSelect formControlName="icon_set">
              <mat-option [value]="'default'">{{ 'Default' }}</mat-option>
              <mat-option [value]="'humanitarian'">{{ 'Humanitarian' }}</mat-option>
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>
          <mat-form-field class="dino-form-attribute-short-field">
            <mat-label>{{'Icon Identifier'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input matInput formControlName="icon" [matAutocomplete]="autoicons" />

            <mat-icon matSuffix *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value === 'default'"
              >{{fgroup.get('icon')?.value}}</mat-icon
            >
            <mat-icon
              matSuffix
              *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value !== 'default'"
              [svgIcon]="fgroup.get('icon')?.value"
            ></mat-icon>
            <mat-autocomplete #autoicons="matAutocomplete">
              <mat-option *ngFor="let icon of filteredIcons | async" [value]="icon">
                <span>{{icon.replace('_', ' ').replace('icon-','').replace('-',' ')}}</span>
                <ng-container *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value === 'default'; else svgIcon"
                  ><mat-icon>{{icon}}</mat-icon></ng-container
                >
                <ng-template #svgIcon><mat-icon [svgIcon]="icon"></mat-icon></ng-template>
              </mat-option>
            </mat-autocomplete>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Form Statuses'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select [disableRipple]="true" formControlName="status" multiple>
              <div
                class="dino-status-option-container"
                *ngFor="let status of availableFormStatuses | async"
              >
                <mat-option class="dino-status-option" [value]="status.id" [matTooltip]="status.label">
                  <span [ngStyle]="{'color': status.color ?? 'inherit'}">{{status.label}}</span>
                </mat-option>
                <button
                  class="dino-status-edit-button"
                  mat-icon-button
                  (click)="openStatusEditor('Edit', status); $event.stopPropagation()"
                  [ngStyle]="{'color': status.color ?? 'inherit'}"
                >
                  <mat-icon>edit</mat-icon>
                </button>
              </div>

              <mat-option class="dino-new-status-button-option">
                <button
                  mat-button
                  color="primary"
                  class="dino-new-status-button"
                  (click)="openStatusEditor('Create'); $event.stopPropagation()"
                >
                  {{'Create new Status'|transloco}}
                  <mat-icon> add </mat-icon>
                </button>
              </mat-option>
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Form Metrics'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select [disableRipple]="true" formControlName="form_schema_metrics" multiple>
              <mat-option
                *ngFor="let availableMetric of availableMetrics|async"
                [value]="availableMetric.metricName"
                >{{availableMetric.label|transloco}}</mat-option
              >
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field class="dino-form-attribute-short-field">
            <mat-label>{{'Visibility'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select formControlName="visibility">
              <mat-option [value]="0">{{ 'Private'|transloco }}</mat-option>
              <mat-option [value]="1">{{ 'Public'|transloco }}</mat-option>
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field class="dino-form-attribute-short-field">
            <mat-label>{{'Metrics Set Behavior'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select formControlName="uniqueMetricsSet">
              <mat-option [value]="false">{{ 'Default'|transloco }}</mat-option>
              <mat-option [value]="true">{{ 'Unique'|transloco }}</mat-option>
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field
            class="dino-form-attribute-short-field"
            *ngIf="(autoReport|async) === null"
          >
            <mat-label>{{'Generate Report'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <mat-select formControlName="generateAutoReport">
              <mat-option [value]="false">{{ 'No'|transloco }}</mat-option>
              <mat-option [value]="true">{{ 'Yes'|transloco }}</mat-option>
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>
        </form>

        <div class="dino-edit-form-schema-actions">
          <button mat-raised-button color="accent" translate (click)="openImportDialog()">
            {{'Import'|transloco}} <mat-icon>file_upload</mat-icon>
          </button>
          <button
            mat-raised-button
            color="accent"
            translate
            (click)="openRelationshipsDialog()"
            [disabled]="(isCreation|async) === true"
          >
            {{'Relationships'|transloco}} <mat-icon>cable</mat-icon>
          </button>
          <button
            mat-raised-button
            color="primary"
            translate
            (click)="save()"
            [disabled]="!fgroup.valid || isSaving || !isAjfFormSchemaValid"
          >
            {{'Save'|transloco}} <mat-icon>save</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ajf-form-builder [form]="form" (formBuilderValidation)="onFormBuilderValidation($event)"></ajf-form-builder>
    </mat-card-content>
  </mat-card>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<h1 class="dino-public-title">{{(formSchema|async)?.label|transloco }}</h1>
<ng-container *ngIf="(submitted|async) === false ; else successMsg">
  <div *ngIf="form|async as currentForm" class="dino-edit-form-step-container">
    <ajf-form
      #formContainer
      [form]="(form|async)!"
      [saveDisabled]="(isValid|async) === false"
      [topBar]="true"
      [maxColumns]="maxColumns"
      [centeredFieldsContent]="centeredFieldsContent"
      (formAction)="onFormAction($event)"
    ></ajf-form>
  </div>

  <dino-floating-button
    buttonIcon="send"
    [tooltipMessage]="'Save form'|transloco"
    [buttonDisabled]="(isValid|async) === false || isSaving"
    (click)="saveForm()"
  ></dino-floating-button>
</ng-container>

<ng-template #successMsg>
  <div class="dino-edit-form-success-container">
    <mat-card appearance="outlined" class="form-container">
      <mat-card-content>
        <h2>{{ 'The form has been successfully submitted.'|transloco }}</h2>
      </mat-card-content>
      <mat-card-actions>
        <mat-icon class="dino-success-msg">check</mat-icon>
      </mat-card-actions>
    </mat-card>
  </div>
</ng-template>
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-edit-public-form {
  font-size: 110%;

  .dino-public-title {
    max-width: 1020px;
    margin: 20px auto;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .dino-edit-form-step-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 90vh;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
      min-height: 80vh;
    }
  }

  .dino-edit-form-success-container {
    max-width: 1020px;
    margin: auto;
    .form-container {
      min-width: 350px;
      border-left: 3px solid;
      border-radius: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0px 2px 4px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%), 0px 4px 5px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 14%),
        0px 1px 10px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
    }
    .mat-mdc-card-content {
      padding: 30px !important;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .mat-mdc-card-actions {
      background-color: rgba($color: #32db64, $alpha: 0.2);
    }
    .dino-success-msg {
      color: #32db64;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
  }

  .ajf-form-container {
    max-width: 1020px;
    margin: auto;

    .ajf-slider-container ajf-page-slider {
      max-height: 87.5%;
      overflow-y: scroll;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
        height: 97.5% !important;
        max-height: 97.5%;
      }
    }
    .ajf-slider-container
      .ajf-page-slider-content
      .ajf-page-slider-body
      .ajf-page-slider-item-content,
    .mat-toolbar-single-row {
      padding: 0px;
      height: auto;
    }
    .ajf-page-slider-content {
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    .mat-toolbar {
      background: transparent;
      &:not(.ajf-toolbar) {
        .ajf-spacer {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      &.ajf-btn-strip {
        .mat-mdc-button.ajf-topbar-button {
          margin-right: 0px;
          background-color: transparent;
          color: rgba(120, 120, 120, 0.63);
          flex: 1 0 auto;
          transition: all ease-in-out 0.25s;
          -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.25s;
          &:hover {
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            color: #fff;
          }
        }
      }
      span {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        text-align: center;
      }
      &:not(.ajf-btn-strip, .ajf-toolbar) {
        display: flex;
        align-content: center;
        .mat-mdc-button {
          display: none;
        }
      }
    }
    .ajf-field-entry label {
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .ajf-form-page {
      .mat-mdc-card {
        margin: 0px !important;
        margin-bottom: 10px !important;
        padding: 8px 8px 8px 0;
        max-width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        flex-flow: column wrap;
        .ajf-field-entry {
          display: flex;
          flex-flow: column wrap;
          justify-content: flex-start;
          /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of button that may no longer apply for the MDC version. */
          label,
          span:not(.mat-ripple, .mat-button-focus-overlay) {
            max-width: 80vw;
            -ms-overflow-style: none;
            scrollbar-width: none;
            &::-webkit-scrollbar {
              display: none;
            }
          }
          ajf-checkbox-group-item {
            flex: 1 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-flow: row wrap;
          }
          .mat-mdc-radio-button,
          ajf-checkbox-group-item .mat-mdc-button {
            .mat-icon {
              color: inherit;
            }
            padding: 10px;
            flex: 1 0 auto;
            min-height: auto;
            align-items: stretch;
            background-color: #fff;
            border: 1px solid rgba(200, 199, 204, 0.7);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            margin-right: 10px;
            line-height: 1.6em;
            label {
              font-weight: normal;
            }
            /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of radio that may no longer apply for the MDC version. */
            .mat-radio-ripple {
              display: none;
            }
          }
          .mat-mdc-select {
            width: 25%;
            @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
              width: 100%;
            }
          }
          ajf-field {
            margin-top: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of select that may no longer apply for the MDC version. */
            .mat-select-min-line,
            .mat-mdc-select-min-line {
              display: inline-block;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .ajf-left-bar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .ajf-slider-container {
    .ajf-info-box.ajf-error {
      visibility: hidden;
    }
  }

  .ajf-toolbar {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .mat-mdc-card.ajf-field-entry {
    border-left-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(300) !important;
    .mat-mdc-card-actions {
      left: 0px;
    }
    .mat-mdc-select-arrow {

        width: 32px;

    .mat-mdc-select {
      .mat-mdc-select-value {
        position: relative;
        box-shadow: 0px 5px 5px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        .mat-mdc-select-min-line {
          white-space: pre-line;
          max-width: 95%;
          overflow: auto;
          text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## File: edit-report/src/edit-report.html
```html
<ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="reportInstance|async as repInstance; else loading">
  <ng-container *ngIf="sourceFormData|async as formDatas">
    <ng-container *ngIf="formDatas.length; else nodata">
      <div #printContainer class="report print">
        <ng-container *ngIf="(metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async) && steps === true">
          <mat-stepper labelPosition="bottom" #stepper linear>
            <mat-step [completed]="(isReportMetricsSelectorValid|async) || (isView|async)">
              <ng-template matStepLabel>{{'REPORT METRICS'|transloco}}</ng-template>
              <div class="dino-edit-report-step-container">
                <dino-form-metric-selector
                  [hasOptionalMetrics]="hasOptionalMetrics"
                  [requiredMetrics]="requiredMetrics|async"
                  [allowMetricCreationFor]="allowMetricCreationFor"
                  [secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed]="secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed"
                  (goToDataEvt)="goToDataStep(stepper)"
                  [availableStatuses]="availableStatuses|async"
                  [context]="'report'"
                >
                  <ng-content
                    metric-selector-message
                    select="[metric-selector-message]"
                  ></ng-content>
                </dino-form-metric-selector>
              </div>
            </mat-step>

            <mat-step [completed]="(isView|async)">
              <ng-template matStepLabel>{{'REPORT DATA'|transloco}}</ng-template>
              <div>
                <button mat-icon-button matStepperPrevious aria-label="Previous step">
                  <mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon>
                </button>
              </div>
              <ng-container *ngIf="reportSchema|async as repschema">
                <ng-container *ngIf="reportData|async as repData">
                  <div class="dino-edit-report-print">
                    {{'Export as:'|transloco}}
                    <button color="primary" mat-raised-button (click)="printReport('portrait')">
                      pdf portrait
                    </button>
                    <button color="primary" mat-raised-button (click)="printReport('landscape')">
                      pdf landscape
                    </button>
                    <button color="primary" mat-raised-button (click)="exportDocx('portrait')">
                      docx portrait
                    </button>
                    <button color="primary" mat-raised-button (click)="exportDocx('landscape')">
                      docx landscape
                    </button>
                    <button color="primary" mat-raised-button (click)="exportXlsx()">xlsx</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="dino-edit-report-info">
                    <h1>{{repschema.label}}</h1>
                    <h2>
                      {{repData.date_start ? ('Collected Since'|transloco) + ' ' +
                      (repData.date_start|dinoDateValue): null}}<br />
                      {{repData.date_end ? ('Collected Until'|transloco) + ' ' +
                      (repData.date_end|dinoDateValue): null}}
                    </h2>
                    <h2 *ngIf="reportMetrics|async as repMetrics">{{repMetrics}}</h2>
                    <!-- <h2>{{('Forms Filled'|transloco)}}: {{formDatas.length}}</h2> -->
                  </div>
                </ng-container>
              </ng-container>
              <div class="dino-edit-report-step-container">
                <ajf-report id="report print" [instance]="repInstance"
                  (filterWidgetChange)="filterWidgetChanged($event)">
                </ajf-report>
              </div>
            </mat-step>
          </mat-stepper>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container *ngIf="(metricsService.hasActiveMetrics|async) === false || steps === false">
          <ng-container *ngIf="reportSchema|async as repschema">
            <ng-container *ngIf="reportData|async as repData">
              <div class="dino-edit-report-info">
                <h1>{{repschema.label}}</h1>
                <h2>
                  {{repData.date_start ? ('Collected Since'|transloco) + ' ' +
                  (repData.date_start|dinoDateValue): null}}<br />
                  {{repData.date_end ? ('Collected Until'|transloco) + ' ' +
                  (repData.date_end|dinoDateValue): null}}
                </h2>
                <h2 *ngIf="reportMetrics|async as repMetrics">{{repMetrics}}</h2>
              </div>
            </ng-container>
          </ng-container>
          <div class="dino-edit-report-step-container" tourAnchor="edit-report">
            <ajf-report id="report print" [instance]="repInstance"
              (filterWidgetChange)="filterWidgetChanged($event)">
            </ajf-report>
          </div>
        </ng-container>
      </div>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
</ng-container>

<ng-template #loading>
  <div class="dino-loading">
    <ng-container *ngIf="(isAILoading|async) === true; else spinnerloading">
      <ng-container *ngIf="AILoadingBarValues|async as barValues">
        <div class="dino-aireport-progress-bar-message">
          <h2>
            {{'Generating report prompt'|transloco}} {{barValues.current}} {{'of'|transloco}}
            {{barValues.total}}
          </h2>
        </div>
        <mat-progress-bar
          class="dino-aireport-progress-bar"
          [value]="barValues.percent"
          mode="buffer"
        ></mat-progress-bar>
      </ng-container>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-template #spinnerloading
      ><ng-container *ngIf="spinnerImagePath; else defaultspinner"
        ><dino-loading-spinner [spinnerImagePath]="spinnerImagePath"></dino-loading-spinner>
      </ng-container>
      <ng-template #defaultspinner
        ><mat-spinner
          class="dino-component-load-spinner"
          mode="indeterminate"
        ></mat-spinner></ng-template
    ></ng-template>
  </div>
</ng-template>

<ng-template #nodata>
  <div class="dino-no-items-message">
    <h1>{{'No Forms were found for this Report'|transloco}}</h1>
  </div>
</ng-template>
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-edit-report {
  canvas {
    min-height: 300px;
  }
  ajf-table {
    table {
      width: -webkit-fill-available;
      border-spacing: 1px;
      border-collapse: separate;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
    }
    td {
      padding: 25px;
    }
    tr {
      th {
        background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500) !important;
        border-bottom: none !important;
      }
    }
  }

  ajf-widget {
    ng-component {
      background-color: transparent !important;
    }
  }

  .dino-edit-report-step-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row wrap;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  .dino-edit-report-step-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 85vh;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
      min-height: 75vh;
    }
    padding-bottom: 15vh;
  }
  .mat-stepper-horizontal {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-content .mat-stepper-previous {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-stepper-header-container {
    border-bottom: 1px solid white;
    .mat-horizontal-stepper-header {
      padding: 8px;
      flex-direction: row;
      &::before,
      &::after {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      .mat-step-label {
        padding: 0px;
        padding-left: 5px;
      }
    }
    .mat-stepper-horizontal-line {
      visibility: hidden;
    }
  }
  .mat-horizontal-content-container {
    padding: 0px 4px 4px;
    @media only screen and (max-height: 900px) {
      padding-bottom: 10vh;
    }
    @media only screen and (max-height: 580px) {
      padding-bottom: 30vh;
    }
  }
  .dino-edit-report-print {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 8px 0;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    span {
      flex-grow: 1;
    }
    button {
      min-width: 50px;
      padding: 0 5px;
      height: 30px !important;
    }
  }
  .dino-edit-report-info {
    text-align: center;
    h1,
    h2 {
      flex: 1 0 auto;
    }
  }
  .dino-no-items-message {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    align-content: center;
    height: 85vh;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  .dino-aireport-progress-bar-message {
    position: relative;
    top: 30%;
    text-align: center;
    margin: auto;
    opacity: 0.6;
    color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
    margin-top: 30vh;
  }
  .dino-loading {
    position: unset !important;
    width: unset !important;
    left: unset !important;
    .dino-sync-text {
      opacity: 0.3;
      text-align: center;
      margin: auto;
      position: relative;
      top: 10em;
      color: inherit;
    }
    .dino-component-load-spinner {
      height: 18vh !important;
      width: 18vw !important;
    }
    .dino-aireport-progress-bar {
      width: 50vw !important;
      margin: auto;
      margin-top: 20px;
      transition: all ease-in-out 0.3;
      -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.3s;
    }
  }
}
.isDarkTheme {
  ajf-text {
    color: rgba(var(--mat-sidenav-content-text-color));
  }

  ajf-table {
    tr:nth-child(even) {
      td {
        background-color: var(--mat-sidenav-container-background-color) !important;
        color: white !important;
      }
    }
    tr:nth-child(odd) {
      td {
        background-color: #616161 !important;
        color: white !important;
      }
    }
  }
}
.isLightTheme {
  ajf-text {
    color: rgba(var(--mat-sidenav-content-text-color));
  }

  ajf-table {
    tr:nth-child(even) {
      td {
        background-color: white !important;
      }
    }
    tr:nth-child(odd) {
      td {
        background-color: rgb(221, 221, 221) !important;
      }
    }
  }
}
```
