## File: edit-report-schema/src/edit-report-schema.html
```html
<mat-card appearance="outlined" class="report-container">
  <ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
  <mat-card-header>
    <ng-container *ngIf="formGroup|async as fgroup">
      <form [formGroup]="fgroup" class="dino-report-attributes">
        <mat-form-field>
          <mat-label>{{'Report Name'|transloco}}</mat-label>
          <input matInput formControlName="name" [placeholder]="'Report Name'" />
          <mat-error *ngIf="fgroup.controls['name'].hasError('incorrect')">
            {{ 'This name is already being used.'|transloco}}
          </mat-error>
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field>
          <mat-label>{{'Report Label'|transloco}}</mat-label>
          <b><input matInput formControlName="label" [placeholder]="'Report Label'" /></b>
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field>
          <mat-label>{{'Icon Set'|transloco}}</mat-label>
          <mat-select
            #iconSetSelect
            formControlName="icon_set"
            [placeholder]="'Icon Set'|transloco"
          >
            <mat-option [value]="'default'">{{ 'Default' }}</mat-option>
            <mat-option [value]="'humanitarian'">{{ 'Humanitarian' }}</mat-option>
          </mat-select>
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field>
          <mat-label>{{'Icon Identifier'|transloco}}</mat-label>
          <input
            matInput
            formControlName="icon"
            [placeholder]="'Icon Identifier'"
            [matAutocomplete]="autoicons"
          />
          <mat-icon matSuffix *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value === 'default'"
            >{{fgroup.get('icon')?.value}}</mat-icon
          >
          <mat-icon
            matSuffix
            *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value !== 'default'"
            [svgIcon]="fgroup.get('icon')?.value"
          ></mat-icon>
          <mat-autocomplete #autoicons="matAutocomplete">
            <mat-option *ngFor="let icon of filteredIcons | async" [value]="icon">
              <span>{{icon.replace('_', ' ').replace('icon-','').replace('-',' ')}}</span>
              <ng-container *ngIf="iconSetSelect.value === 'default'; else svgIcon"
                ><mat-icon>{{icon}}</mat-icon></ng-container
              >
              <ng-template #svgIcon><mat-icon [svgIcon]="icon"></mat-icon></ng-template>
            </mat-option>
          </mat-autocomplete>
        </mat-form-field>

        <mat-form-field>
          <mat-label>{{'Required Metrics'|transloco}}</mat-label>
          <mat-select [disableRipple]="true" formControlName="required_metrics" multiple>
            <mat-option
              *ngFor="let availableMetric of availableMetrics|async"
              [value]="availableMetric.metricName"
              >{{availableMetric.label|transloco}}</mat-option
            >
          </mat-select>
        </mat-form-field>
      </form>

      <div class="dino-edit-report-schema-actions">
        <button mat-raised-button color="accent" translate (click)="openImportDialog()">
          Import <mat-icon>file_upload</mat-icon>
        </button>
        <button
          mat-raised-button
          color="primary"
          translate
          (click)="save()"
          [disabled]="!fgroup.valid"
        >
          Save <mat-icon>save</mat-icon>
        </button>
      </div>
    </ng-container>
  </mat-card-header>
  <mat-card-content>
    <h2 class="subtitle">{{'Associated Form Schemas'|transloco}}</h2>
    <mat-chip-set aria-label="Used Form Schemas">
      <mat-chip disabled *ngFor="let formSchema of formSchemas|async">{{formSchema.label}}</mat-chip>
    </mat-chip-set>
  
    <h2 class="subtitle">{{'Report Preview'|transloco}}</h2>
    <ng-container *ngIf="reportInstance$|async as reportInstance">
      <ajf-report [instance]="reportInstance"></ajf-report>
    </ng-container>
  </mat-card-content>
</mat-card>
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="importReport">
  <mat-card appearance="outlined" class="form-container">
    <mat-toolbar color="primary"> Import report</mat-toolbar>
    <mat-card-content>
      <form [formGroup]="importReport">
        <div class="dino-upload-container">
          <div>Upload an xls report file to modify the schema:<br /></div>
          <input
            type="file"
            id="excelFileInput"
            accept=".xls,.xlsx"
            (change)="onExcelfileSelected($event)"
            style="visibility: hidden; height: 1px"
          /><br />
          <label for="excelFileInput">
            <a color="primary" mat-raised-button>Choose file</a>
          </label>
        </div>
      </form>
      <br />
    </mat-card-content>
    <mat-card-actions>
      <button (click)="closeDialog()" color="warn" mat-raised-button>
        {{ 'Cancel' }}
      </button>
      <button
        [disabled]="!importReport.valid"
        (click)="apply()"
        color="primary"
        mat-raised-button
      >
        {{ 'Apply' }}
      </button>
    </mat-card-actions>
  </mat-card>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="exportModel$|async as exportModel">
  <mat-toolbar class="dino-button-focus-action">
    <ng-container *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) !== true">
      <mat-button-toggle-group
        name="filters"
        aria-label="export filters"
        [(ngModel)]="exportFilters"
      >
        <mat-button-toggle value="displayed">{{'Items in page'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle>
        <mat-button-toggle *ngIf="filtersCount > 0; else noFilter" value="filtered"
          >{{'All items'|transloco}} / {{filtersCount}} {{'filters'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle
        >
        <ng-template #noFilter>
          <mat-button-toggle
            value="add-filters"
            (click)="closeDialog()"
            [matTooltip]="'Close the dialog and apply filters.'|transloco"
            matTooltipPosition="above"
            >{{'Add filters'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle
          >
        </ng-template>
        <mat-button-toggle
          value="not-filtered"
          [matTooltip]="'This option exports all items without filters. The process may slow down your device.'|transloco"
          matTooltipPosition="right"
          matTooltipClass="warning-tooltip"
          >{{'All items'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle
        >
      </mat-button-toggle-group>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) === true">
      <mat-form-field class="dino-platform-dropdown" dropdownSelect>
        <mat-label>{{'Filters'|transloco}}</mat-label>
        <mat-select
          (selectionChange)="updateFilters($event)"
          [(ngModel)]="exportFilters"
          [value]="'displayed'"
        >
          <mat-option
            class="dino-status-option"
            *ngFor="let choice of availableFilters"
            [value]="choice.value"
          >
            <span>{{choice.label| transloco}}</span>
          </mat-option>
        </mat-select>
      </mat-form-field>
    </ng-container>
    <span class="dino-spacer"></span>

    <button
      mat-flat-button
      color="accent"
      class="dino-export-button"
      (click)="export()"
      [disabled]="disableExport$|async"
    >
      <ng-container *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) !== true">
        {{'Export'|transloco}}
      </ng-container>
      <mat-icon matSuffix>cloud_download</mat-icon>
    </button>
  </mat-toolbar>
  <mat-toolbar class="dino-export-options">
    <mat-form-field
      class="dino-platform-dropdown"
      *ngIf="dialogData.listType === 'forms'"
      dropdownSelect
    >
      <mat-label>{{'Fields and formats'|transloco}}</mat-label>
      <mat-select
        (selectionChange)="updateFieldsAndFormats($event)"
        [(ngModel)]="selectedFieldsAndFormats"
        multiple
      >
        <mat-option
          class="dino-status-option"
          *ngFor="let choice of availableFieldsAndFormats"
          [value]="choice.value"
          [disabled]="(choice.value === 'separate_columns' && selectedFieldsAndFormats.includes('data_analysis')) || (choice.value === 'data_analysis' && selectedFieldsAndFormats.includes('separate_columns'))"
        >
          <span>{{choice.label| transloco}}</span>
        </mat-option>
      </mat-select>
    </mat-form-field>
    <span class="dino-export-toolbar-spacer" *ngIf="dialogData.listType === 'forms'"></span>
    <mat-button-toggle-group name="format" aria-label="format of export" [(ngModel)]="exportFormat">
      <mat-button-toggle value="csv">{{'csv'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle>
      <mat-button-toggle value="xlsx">{{'xlsx'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle>
      <mat-button-toggle value="splitted-xlsx">{{'splitted xlsx'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle>
    </mat-button-toggle-group>
  </mat-toolbar>
  <mat-tab-group selectedIndex="0" (selectedTabChange)="tabChange($event)">
    <mat-tab
      *ngFor="let label of exportModel.slideLabels; let idx = index"
      [label]="label|transloco"
    >
      <dino-toggle-button [group]="'tab'" (change)="selectAllfieldSlides($event.checked)">
        {{'Select all fields of'|transloco}} {{label| transloco}}
      </dino-toggle-button>
      <mat-selection-list
        [attr.aria-label]="'slide fields'|transloco"
        (selectionChange)="updateExportDisable()"
        *ngIf="exportModel.slides[idx] as slide"
      >
        <mat-list-option *ngFor="let field of slide" [value]="field">
          {{field.label| transloco}}
        </mat-list-option>
      </mat-selection-list>
    </mat-tab>
  </mat-tab-group>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(isDownloading|async) === true">
    <mat-spinner class="dino-component-load-spinner" mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner>
  </ng-container>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="draggable; else undraggable"
  ><button
    cdkDrag
    aria-label="An action floating button"
    class="mat-fab-bottom-right"
    [routerLink]="buttonUrl"
    [matTooltip]="tooltipMessage || ''"
    [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
    [disabled]="buttonDisabled"
    mat-fab
  >
    <button
      mat-mini-fab
      class="floating-handle"
      color="primary"
      aria-label="Drag handle"
      cdkDragHandle
      (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); $event.preventDefault();"
    >
      <mat-icon>open_with</mat-icon>
    </button>
    <mat-icon class="icon">{{buttonIcon}}</mat-icon>
  </button></ng-container
>

<ng-template #undraggable
  ><button
    aria-label="An action floating button"
    [ngClass]="'mat-fab-bottom-right ' + (tourInteractive ? 'dino-tour-interactive-anchor' : '')"
    [routerLink]="buttonUrl"
    [matTooltip]="tooltipMessage || ''"
    [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
    [tourAnchor]="tourAnchor ?? ''"
    [disabled]="buttonDisabled"
    mat-fab
    [extended]="cost !== undefined && cost !== null && cost > 0"
  >
    <mat-icon class="icon">{{buttonIcon}}</mat-icon>
    <div
      *ngIf="cost"
      class="dino-floating-button-cost-container"
      [tourAnchor]="tourAnchor ? tourAnchor+'-credits' : ''"
    >
      <mat-icon color="primary">smart_toy</mat-icon>
      <div class="dino-tokens-counter-amount">{{cost}}</div>
    </div>
  </button></ng-template
>
```

```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

.mat-fab-bottom-right {
  position: fixed !important;
  right: 2vw;
  bottom: 22.5vh;
  z-index: 10;
  opacity: 0.7;
  &:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    transition: all ease-in-out 0.5;
    -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.5s;
  }
  .floating-handle {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -4px;
    right: -4px;
    cursor: move;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    .mat-mdc-button-touch-target {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }
    .mat-icon {
      font-size: 16px;
      position: relative;
      top: 4px;
    }
  }
  .dino-floating-button-cost-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    align-items: center;
    .dino-tokens-counter-amount {
      color: var(--mat-badge-text-color);
      background: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      padding: 2px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .mat-icon {
      margin-right: 5px;
    }
  }
}

    bottom: 12vh;
  }
}
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="formSchema|async as fs">
  <h3 matDialogTitle>{{'Edit Form Relationships'|transloco}} - {{fs.name|transloco}}</h3>
  <mat-dialog-content>
    <div class="subtitle">
      <h3>{{'Selects metrics for which data should be included in the form'|transloco}}</h3>
      <mat-form-field>
        <mat-label>{{'Select metrics'|transloco}}</mat-label>
        <mat-select [value]="currentMetricsForData" #metricsForData multiple>
          <mat-option *ngFor="let metric of activeMetrics" [value]="metric">
            <span> {{metric|transloco}}</span>
          </mat-option>
        </mat-select>
      </mat-form-field>
    </div>

    <div class="subtitle">
      <button (click)="addMetricRow()" mat-button>
        <mat-icon>add</mat-icon>
        <h3>{{'Selects metrics to be included as choice options'|transloco}}
          <mat-icon class="tooltip-icon"
            [matTooltip]="'Selects the metrics to be included as choice options in the form schema. The name of the new choice origin will be $metricName_metric_choice.'|transloco"
            matTooltipPosition="right">help</mat-icon>
        </h3>
      </button>
      <mat-table class="deps-metrics-table" [dataSource]="metricDataSource">
        <ng-container matColumnDef="delete">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Delete'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-icon (click)="deleteMetricRow(idx)">delete</mat-icon>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="metric_name">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Metric'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-select matNativeControl [(ngModel)]="row.metric_name" [required]="true"
                (selectionChange)="getQueryForMetric(row)">
                <mat-option *ngFor="let metric of activeMetrics" [value]="metric">
                  <span> {{metric|transloco}}</span>
                </mat-option>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="choice_extra_value_key">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Additional attributes in choice'|transloco}}
            <mat-icon class="tooltip-icon"
              [matTooltip]="'Enter the name of the metric field or attributes to add to the choice, separated by commas. They can be used later in the choice_filter.'|transloco"
              matTooltipPosition="right">help</mat-icon>
          </mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <input matInput [(ngModel)]="row.choices_origin.extra_value_key"
                [placeholder]="('Attribute names'|transloco)" />
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container matColumnDef="filter_by">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Filter condition'|transloco}}
            <mat-icon [matTooltip]="'Insert a formula to filter metrics, using metric fields or attributes'|transloco"
              matTooltipPosition="right" matTooltipClass="my-tooltip">help</mat-icon>
          </mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <input matInput [(ngModel)]="row.filter_by" [placeholder]="('Filter condition'|transloco)"
                (ngModelChange)="getQueryForMetric(row)" />
            </mat-form-field>
            <div class="dino-error" *ngIf="row.query_selector && row.query_selector.error">
              {{row.query_selector.error}}
            </div>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>

        <mat-header-row *matHeaderRowDef="displayedMetricsColumns"></mat-header-row>
        <mat-row *matRowDef="let row; columns: displayedMetricsColumns;"></mat-row>
      </mat-table>
    </div>

    <div class="subtitle">
      <button (click)="addRow()" mat-button>
        <mat-icon>add</mat-icon>
        <h3>{{'Add relationship with other forms'|transloco}}</h3>
      </button>
      <mat-table class="deps-table" [dataSource]="dataSource">
        <ng-container matColumnDef="delete">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Delete'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-icon (click)="deleteRow(idx)">delete</mat-icon>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="form_schema_ref_id">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Form Schema'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-select matNativeControl [(ngModel)]="row.form_schema_ref_id" [required]="true">
                <mat-option *ngFor="let s of (availableSchemas|async)" [value]="s.id" [matTooltip]="s.name"
                  [matTooltipPosition]="'right'">
                  <span> {{s.name|transloco}}</span>
                </mat-option>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="fields_to_update">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Fields'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-select [(ngModel)]="row.fields_to_update" [placeholder]="'Form fields'|transloco" multiple
                (selectionChange)="checkChoiceOption($event, idx)" [required]="true">
                <ng-container *ngIf="row.form_schema_ref_id">
                  <mat-option *ngFor="let field of schemaFields$[row.form_schema_ref_id]" [value]="field"
                    [matTooltip]="field" [matTooltipPosition]="'right'">{{field}}</mat-option>
                </ng-container>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="filter_by_metric">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Metric'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-select matNativeControl [(ngModel)]="row.filter_by_metric" multiple
                (selectionChange)="changeMetrics($event)">
                <mat-option *ngFor="let metric of activeMetrics" [value]="metric">
                  <span> {{metric|transloco}}</span>
                </mat-option>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-container matColumnDef="is_choice">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Create choices'|transloco}} {{'(select only one
            field)'|transloco}}
            <mat-icon class="tooltip-icon"
              [matTooltip]="'Use selected field (only one allowed) as choice option. The name of the new choice origin added to the form schema will be $fieldName_choice.'|transloco"
              matTooltipPosition="right">help</mat-icon>
          </mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-slide-toggle [(ngModel)]="row.is_choice" [disabled]="row.fields_to_update.length > 1"
              style="margin: 10px" aria-label="Is choice"></mat-slide-toggle>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container matColumnDef="choice_label_fields">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Field to use as label'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field *ngIf="row.is_choice">
              <mat-select [(ngModel)]="row.choices_origin.label_fields" [placeholder]="'Label fields'|transloco"
                multiple>
                <ng-container *ngIf="row.form_schema_ref_id">
                  <mat-option *ngFor="let field of schemaFields$[row.form_schema_ref_id]" [value]="field"
                    [matTooltip]="field" [matTooltipPosition]="'left'">{{field}}</mat-option>
                </ng-container>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>

        <ng-container matColumnDef="choice_extra_value_key">
          <mat-header-cell *matHeaderCellDef>{{'Additional field'|transloco}}</mat-header-cell>
          <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row; let idx = index">
            <mat-form-field *ngIf="row.is_choice">
              <mat-select [(ngModel)]="row.choices_origin.extra_value_key" [placeholder]="'Additional field'|transloco">
                <ng-container *ngIf="row.form_schema_ref_id">
                  <mat-option [value]=""> </mat-option>
                  <mat-option *ngFor="let field of schemaFields$[row.form_schema_ref_id]" [value]="field"
                    [matTooltip]="field" [matTooltipPosition]="'left'">{{field}}</mat-option>
                </ng-container>
              </mat-select>
            </mat-form-field>
          </mat-cell>
        </ng-container>

        <mat-header-row *matHeaderRowDef="displayedColumns"></mat-header-row>
        <mat-row *matRowDef="let row; columns: displayedColumns;"></mat-row>
      </mat-table>
    </div>
  </mat-dialog-content>

  <div mat-dialog-actions>
    <button mat-raised-button color="warn" (click)="closeDialog()">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
    <button mat-raised-button color="primary" (click)="saveDeps(metricsForData.value)">{{'Save'|transloco}}</button>
  </div>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<mat-dialog-content>
  <dino-form-metric-selector
    [hasOptionalMetrics]="data.hasOptionalMetrics"
    [allowMetricCreationFor]="allowMetricCreationFor"
    [context]="data.context"
    [availableStatuses]="availableStatuses|async"
    [setDialogActRouteParams]="data.routeParams"
    [secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed]="data.secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed"
  >
    <div bulk-edit-message>
      {{'Leave a field empty if you do not wish to change the related value of the selected forms'|transloco}}
    </div>
    <div share-url-message>
      {{'Choose which metrics the Public Form Url will refer to, if any, then copy the Url into your Clipboard'|transloco}}
    </div>
  </dino-form-metric-selector>
  <div
    class="dino-bulk-edit-error"
    *ngIf="(uniqueMetricsSetAlreadyExists$ | async) === true"
  >
    <mat-error *ngIf="data.formDatas.length > 1 && (numMetrics$ | async) === 1">
      {{ "Cannot bulk-edit the only metric of this schema because it must be unique for each record." | transloco }}
    </mat-error>
    <mat-error *ngIf="data.formDatas.length > 1 && (numMetrics$ | async) !== 1">
      {{ "This combination of metrics already exists for another record. Please choose a different combination." | transloco }}
    </mat-error>
    <mat-error *ngIf="data.formDatas.length === 1">
      {{ "A record with this exact set of Metrics already exists. Please choose different Metrics." | transloco }}
    </mat-error>
  </div>
</mat-dialog-content>

<mat-dialog-actions>
  <button mat-raised-button color="warn" (click)="closeDialog()">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
  <button *ngIf="data.context !== 'shareUrl'" mat-raised-button color="primary" (click)="save()" [disabled]="(uniqueMetricsSetAlreadyExists$ | async) === true">
    {{'Save'|transloco}}
  </button>
  <button *ngIf="data.context === 'shareUrl'" mat-raised-button color="primary" (click)="shareUrl()">
    {{'Copy to Clipboard'|transloco}} <mat-icon>share</mat-icon>
  </button>
</mat-dialog-actions>
```

## File: form-metric-selector/src/form-metric-selector.html
```html
<div
  class="dino-form-metric-selector-container"
  [class.dino-form-metric-selector-dialog-container]="context === 'bulkFormEdit' || context === 'shareUrl' "
>
  <div class="dino-additional-selector-message" *ngIf="context === 'bulkFormEdit'">
    <ng-content select="[bulk-edit-message]"></ng-content>
  </div>
  <div class="dino-additional-selector-message" *ngIf="context === 'shareUrl'">
    <ng-content select="[share-url-message]"></ng-content>
  </div>
  <br /><br />
  <div class="dino-form-metric-selector-message">
    <ng-content select="[metric-selector-message]"></ng-content>
  </div>

  <form [formGroup]="formDate" autocomplete="off" *ngIf="context !== 'shareUrl'">
    <mat-form-field
      class="dino-form-date-selector-field"
      appearance="fill"
      tourAnchor="metric-selector-creation-date"
    >
      <mat-label>{{'Creation Date'|transloco}}</mat-label>
      <input
        matInput
        readonly
        [matDatepicker]="pickerDate"
        [formControlName]="'created_at'"
        [placeholder]="'mm/dd/yyyy'"
      />
      <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerDate"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
      <mat-datepicker [xPosition]="'end'" #pickerDate></mat-datepicker>
    </mat-form-field>
  </form>
  <form
    *ngIf="(context === 'bulkFormEdit' || context === 'report') && availableStatuses && availableStatuses.length;"
    [formGroup]="formStatus"
    autocomplete="off"
  >
    <mat-form-field class="dino-form-status-selector-field" tourAnchor="metric-selector-status">
      <mat-label>{{'Select the Form Status'|transloco}}</mat-label>
      <mat-select
        #statusSelect
        [formControlName]="'form_status_ref_id'"
        [placeholder]="'Form status associated with the form'"
      >
        <mat-option [value]="null"></mat-option>
        <mat-option *ngFor="let status of availableStatuses" [value]="status.id">
          <span [ngStyle]="{'color': status.color ?? 'inherit'}"> {{status.label|transloco}}</span>
        </mat-option>
      </mat-select>
    </mat-form-field>
  </form>
  <form [formGroup]="formMetrics" autocomplete="off">
    <ng-container *ngFor="let field of formMetricsFields|async let idx = index">
      <mat-form-field class="dino-form-metric-selector-field" appearance="fill">
        <input
          matInput
          [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
          [placeholder]="(field.placeholder ?? '')|transloco"
          [matAutocomplete]="auto"
        />

        <mat-icon
          *ngIf="(isView|async) !== true && isMetricCreationAllowed(field.fieldName)"
          matSuffix
          color="primary"
          class="dino-add-metric-button"
          (click)="openCreateMetricDialog($event, field.fieldName)"
          >add</mat-icon
        >

        <mat-icon matSuffix>{{field.icon}}</mat-icon>

        <mat-autocomplete
          #auto="matAutocomplete"
          [autoActiveFirstOption]="false"
          [displayWith]="displayMetricName"
        >
          <mat-option
            *ngFor="let option of formMetricsOptions[field.fieldName] | async"
            [value]="{option, secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed, metricType: field.fieldName}"
            [ngClass]="'dino-option-level-' + (option.level ?? '0')"
          >
            {{displayMetricName({option, secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed, metricType:
            field.fieldName})}}
          </mat-option>
        </mat-autocomplete>

        <mat-error *ngIf="formMetrics.controls[field.fieldName].hasError('required')">
          {{ 'Please enter a'|transloco}} {{field.fieldName}}
        </mat-error>

        <mat-error *ngIf="formMetrics.controls[field.fieldName].hasError('incorrect')">
          {{ 'Please select a valid'|transloco}} {{field.fieldName|titlecase|transloco}}
        </mat-error>

        <mat-hint>{{field.hint|transloco}}</mat-hint>
      </mat-form-field>
    </ng-container>
  </form>
  <div class="dino-go-to-data-button-container" *ngIf="context === 'form'">
    <button
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      [disabled]="formMetrics.status === 'INVALID'"
      class="dino-go-to-data-button dino-tour-interactive-anchor"
      (click)="goToData()"
      tourAnchor="go-to-data-button"
    >
      {{((isView|async) !== true) ? ('Fill the Form'|transloco) : ('View the Form'|transloco)}}
      <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
    </button>

    <button *ngIf="(isCreate|async) === true && isRecordAudioEnabled"
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      [disabled]="(formMetrics.status === 'INVALID') || (nss.isOnline$|async) === false"
      class="dino-go-to-data-button"
      (click)="openRecordAudioDialog()"
    >
      {{('Transcribe the Form'|transloco)}}
      <mat-icon>mic</mat-icon>
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="dino-go-to-data-button-container" *ngIf="context === 'report'">
    <button
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      [disabled]="formMetrics.status === 'INVALID'"
      class="dino-go-to-data-button dino-tour-interactive-anchor"
      (click)="goToData()"
      tourAnchor="go-to-data-button"
    >
    {{((isView|async) !== true) ? ('Next'|transloco) : ('View the Report'|transloco)}}
    <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```scss
    display: inline-block !important;
    margin-left: 15px;
  }

    opacity: 0.5;
    transition: all 0.5s ease-in-out;
    font-size: 32px;
    position: relative;
    bottom: 2px;
    &:hover {
      opacity: 1;

      min-width: unset;

      .dino-form-metric-selector-field,
      .dino-form-date-selector-field,
      .dino-form-status-selector-field {
        min-width: 60vw;
        display: block;
        .mat-datepicker-toggle {
          position: relative;
        }

        position: relative;

      }

    flex-flow: row wrap;

    .dino-go-to-data-button {
      margin-top: 50px;

      font-size: 16px;

  }
```

```html
    <mat-form-field>
      <mat-label>{{'Select the Form Status'|transloco}}</mat-label>
```

```html
<div>
  <h1 mat-dialog-title>
    {{data.statusAction | transloco}} {{'Form Status'|transloco}} {{data.statusItem ? ': "' +
    data.statusItem.label + '"' : ''}}
  </h1>
  <mat-dialog-content>
    <form *ngIf="statusForm" [formGroup]="statusForm" autocomplete="off">
      <mat-form-field class="dino-status-editor-field" appearance="fill">
        <input
          matInput
          type="text"
          [formControlName]="'name'"
          [placeholder]="'Name'|transloco"
          value="{{data.statusItem?.name}}"
        />
        <mat-hint>{{'Form Status'|transloco}}: {{'Name' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
      </mat-form-field>
      <mat-form-field class="dino-status-editor-field" appearance="fill">
        <input
          matInput
          type="text"
          [formControlName]="'label'"
          [placeholder]="'Label'|transloco"
          value="{{data.statusItem?.label}}"
        />
        <mat-hint>{{'Form Status'|transloco}}: {{'Label' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
      </mat-form-field>
      <mat-form-field class="dino-status-editor-field" appearance="fill">
        <input
          matInput
          type="number"
          [formControlName]="'status_level'"
          [placeholder]="'Status Level'|transloco"
          value="{{data.statusItem?.status_level}}"
        />
        <mat-hint>{{'Form Status'|transloco}}: {{'Priority' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
      </mat-form-field>
      <mat-form-field
        class="dino-status-editor-field"
        appearance="fill"
        [style.color]="statusColor"
        [colorPicker]="statusColor"
        (colorPickerChange)="statusColor=$event"
      >
        <input
          matInput
          readonly
          [formControlName]="'color'"
          [placeholder]="'Color'|transloco"
          [value]="statusColor"
        />
        <mat-icon matSuffix>palette</mat-icon>
        <mat-hint>{{'Form Status'|transloco}}: {{'Color' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
      </mat-form-field>
    </form>
  </mat-dialog-content>
  <div mat-dialog-actions>
    <button mat-raised-button color="warn" (click)="closeEditor();">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
    <button
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      [mat-dialog-close]="null"
      cdkFocusInitial
      (click)="saveStatus()"
      [disabled]="!isFormValid()"
    >
      {{'Save'|transloco}}
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```html
<ng-container *ngIf="importForm">
  <mat-card appearance="outlined" class="form-container">
    <mat-toolbar color="primary"> {{'Import forms'|transloco}}</mat-toolbar>
    <mat-card-content>
      <form [formGroup]="importForm">
        <div class="dino-upload-container">
          <div>Upload an xls or csv file to import form data:<br /></div>
          <input
            type="file"
            id="excelFileInput"
            accept=".xls,.xlsx,.csv"
            (change)="onExcelfileSelected($event)"
            style="visibility: hidden; height: 1px"
          /><br />
          <label for="excelFileInput">
            <a color="primary" mat-raised-button>{{'Choose file'|transloco}}</a>
          </label>
          <mat-checkbox formControlName="reuseMetricName"
            >{{'Reuse metrics if name exists'|transloco}}</mat-checkbox
          >
        </div>
      </form>
      <div *ngIf="importStatus" class="dino-upload-respose">
        <b>{{importStatus}}</b>
      </div>
      <br />
    </mat-card-content>
    <mat-card-actions>
      <button (click)="closeDialog()" color="warn" mat-raised-button>
        {{ 'Close'|transloco }}
      </button>
      <button [disabled]="processing" (click)="apply()" color="primary" mat-raised-button>
        {{ 'Apply'|transloco }}
      </button>
    </mat-card-actions>
  </mat-card>
</ng-container>
```

```html
<div mat-dialog-title>
  <button class="dino-add" mat-fab (click)="addLang()">
    <mat-icon>add</mat-icon>
  </button>
  <div>
    <span>{{'language'|transloco|uppercase}}: </span>
    <button
      mat-button
      *ngFor="let langName of (langNames$|async)"
      [color]="langName === (currentLangName$|async)?'primary':''"
      (click)="setCurrentLang(langName)"
    >
      {{langName}}
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="dino-buttons" *ngIf="(currentLang$|async) as currentLang">
    <button mat-button color="warn" (click)="remove()">
      {{'Remove custom translation'|transloco}}
    </button>
    <dino-langs-file-uploader
      fileType="json"
      (uploaded)="setUploaded($event)"
      (errors)="setError($event)"
    >
      {{'Update translation'|transloco}}
    </dino-langs-file-uploader>
  </div>
</div>
<div mat-dialog-content>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(currentLang$|async) as currentLang;else newLang">
    <ng-container
      *ngIf="((diff$|async) === null || (diff$|async) === undefined) && ((modified$|async) === null || (modified$|async) === undefined)"
    >
      {{currentLang.schema|dinoObjectLength}} {{'rows'|transloco}}:
      <pre>{{currentLang.schema|json}}</pre>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(diff$|async) as diff">
      {{'added'|transloco}} {{diff|dinoObjectLength}} {{'rows'|transloco}}:
      <pre class="dino-diff">{{diff|json}}</pre>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(modified$|async) as modified">
      {{'modified'|transloco}} {{modified|dinoObjectLength}} {{'rows'|transloco}}:
      <pre class="dino-modified">{{modified|json}}</pre>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
  <ng-template #newLang>
    <form [formGroup]="form">
      <mat-form-field>
        <mat-label>{{'Add lang label'|transloco}}</mat-label>
        <input
          matInput
          formControlName="key"
          type="text"
          placeholder="{{'Add lang label'|transloco}}"
        />
      </mat-form-field>
    </form>
    <dino-langs-file-uploader
      fileType="json"
      (uploaded)="setNewTranslation($event)"
      (errors)="setError($event)"
      (name)="setName($event)"
    >
      {{'Add JSON'|transloco}}
    </dino-langs-file-uploader>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(newLang$|async) as newLang">
      {{newLang.schema|dinoObjectLength}} {{'rows'|transloco}}:
      <pre>{{newLang.schema|json}}</pre>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-template>
</div>
<div mat-dialog-actions>
  <button mat-raised-button color="accent" (click)="close()">{{'Undo'|transloco}}</button>
  <button mat-raised-button [mat-dialog-close]="" (click)="save()" cdkFocusInitial color="primary">
    {{'Save'|transloco}}
  </button>
</div>
```

```scss
    div:nth-child(3) {
      order: 0;
      flex: 0 1 auto;
      align-self: auto;
    }
    div:nth-child(2) {
      order: 0;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      align-self: auto;
    }
    div:nth-child(1) {
      mat-button-toggle-group {
        margin-left: 20px;
      }
    }
  }
  .dino-langs-selected {
    color: rebeccapurple;
    margin-left: 2px;
  }
  .dino-langs-no-translation {
    color: red;
    margin-left: 2px;
  }
}
```

```html
      <mat-slide-toggle
        [checked]="column.displayed || column.displayed === undefined"

    {{'Apply'|transloco}}
```

## File: list/src/list-cell-component.html
```html
<!-- Cell Container -->
<ng-container *ngIf="!(item|dinoListCellIsFile); else fileTemplate">
  <ng-container *ngIf="!(item|dinoListCellIsStorageImageUrl);else imageTemplate">
    <ng-container
      *ngIf="header?.fieldType === 3 &&
      header?.isEditable &&
      rowElement &&
      header?.isEditable(rowElement);
      then booleanCellTemplate; else standardCellTemplate"
    />
  </ng-container>
</ng-container>

<!-- ---- CELL TEMPLATES ---- -->

<!-- Image Cell template -->
<ng-template #imageTemplate>
  <ng-container
    *ngIf="!(item|dinoListCellIsDeletedFile);
    then validImageTemplate; else deletedFileTemplate"
  />
</ng-template>

<!-- File Cell Template -->
<ng-template #fileTemplate>
  <ng-container
    *ngIf="!(item|dinoListCellIsDeletedFile);
    then validFileTemplate; else deletedFileTemplate"
  />
</ng-template>

<!-- Valid Image Cell template -->
<ng-template #validImageTemplate>
  <mat-icon (click)="previewMethod ? previewMethod($event, item) : null" class="dino-file-cell-icon"
    >photo_camera</mat-icon
  ></ng-template
>

<!-- Valid File Cell template -->
<ng-template #validFileTemplate>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(item|dinoListCellGetFile) as fileItem">
    <ng-container *ngIf="item|dinoListCellGetFileIcon as fileIcon">
      <ng-container *ngIf="fileItem | dinoFileView as fileView">

        <!-- DOWNLOAD / URL -->
        <a *ngIf="!fileView.isImage && fileView.href" [href]="fileView.href"
          [attr.target]="fileView.targetBlank ? '_blank' : null" [attr.download]="fileView.download ? '' : null">

          <mat-icon class="dino-file-cell-icon">
            {{ fileIcon }}
          </mat-icon>
        </a>

        <!-- IMAGE -->
        <mat-icon *ngIf="fileView.isImage" (click)="previewMethod?.($event, item)" class="dino-file-cell-icon">
          {{ fileIcon }}
        </mat-icon>

        <!-- FALLBACK -->
        <ng-container *ngIf="!fileView.isImage && !fileView.href">
          {{ item }}
        </ng-container>

      </ng-container>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
</ng-template>

<!-- Deleted file Cell template -->
<ng-template #deletedFileTemplate></ng-template>

<!-- Boolean Cell template -->
<ng-template #booleanCellTemplate>
  <div (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
    <mat-slide-toggle
      [checked]="item === true"
      (change)="toggleBoolean($event)"
      aria-label="Edit boolean field"
    ></mat-slide-toggle>
  </div>
</ng-template>

<!-- Standard Cell template -->
<ng-template #standardCellTemplate>
  <ng-container *ngIf="isUrl(item); then urlTemplate; else standardTextCellTemplate"></ng-container>
</ng-template>

<!-- Link Cell temlate -->
<ng-template #urlTemplate
  ><a class="dino-link-cell" [matTooltip]="item" [href]="item" target="_blank">Link</a></ng-template
>

<!-- Standard Text Cell template -->
<ng-template #standardTextCellTemplate>
  <ng-container
    *ngIf="isSingleWordLongString(item, 25);then longStandardCellTemplate;  else regularStandardCellTemplate"
    ><div class="dino-text-cell-long" [matTooltip]="item">{{item}}</div></ng-container
  >
</ng-template>

<!-- Long Standard Text Cell template -->
<ng-template #longStandardCellTemplate
  ><div class="dino-text-cell-long" [matTooltip]="item">{{item}}</div></ng-template
>

<!-- Regular Standard Text Cell template -->
<ng-template #regularStandardCellTemplate>{{item}}</ng-template>
```

```typescript
export interface ListContext<T extends Model = Model, U extends Model = Model> {
  /**
   * List headers
   */
  headers: BehaviorSubject<ListHeader<T>[]>;

  /**
   * The list data source
   */
  dataSource?: ListDataSource<T, U>;

  /**
   * Columns to be  displayed
   */
  displayedColumns?: BehaviorSubject<string[]>;

  /**
   * The actions allowed on the list rows
   */
  listRowActions?: BehaviorSubject<ListAction[]>;

  /**
   * If true, the Status Edit button is displayed
   */
  showStatusEdit?: BehaviorSubject<boolean>;

  /**
   * If true, the selection checkboxes are displayed
   */
  showCheckBox?: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, the MatPaginator is displayed
   */
  showPaginator?: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, the Columns selector is displayed
   */
  showColumnsSelector?: boolean;

  /**
   * The url base path for editing the row
   */
  baseEditUrl?: string;

  /**
   * If true, the rows can be expanded
   */
  expandable?: string;

  /**
   * If true,  the list is a Details List.
   */
  isDetails?: boolean;
}
```

## File: list/src/list.html
```html
<div class="dino-list-toolbar">
  <ng-content select="[breadcrumbs]"></ng-content>
  <ng-container *ngIf="dataSource">
    <div class="dino-list-count">
      <mat-icon color="primary">numbers</mat-icon>
      <span>{{'Items found'|transloco}}: </span>
      <ng-container *ngIf="(dataSource.dataResultsCount|async) !== null; else loadingCountTemplate"
        ><span><b>{{dataSource.dataResultsCount|async}}</b></span></ng-container
      >
      <ng-template #loadingCountTemplate
        ><mat-icon class="dino-loading-count-icon">data_usage</mat-icon></ng-template
      >
    </div>
    <mat-paginator
      #pag
      [length]="dataSource.dataResultsCount|async"
      [showFirstLastButtons]="true"
    ></mat-paginator>
  </ng-container>
</div>
<ng-content select="[filters]"></ng-content>
<ng-container *ngIf="expandable && displayExpandAllBtn">
  <button
    mat-icon-button
    color="primary"
    aria-label="Fold or unfold all rows button"
    (click)="expandAllRows.next(!expandAllRows.getValue())"
    class="dino-expand-all-button"
  >
    <mat-icon>{{(expandAllRows|async) ? 'unfold_less' : 'unfold_more' }}</mat-icon>
  </button>
</ng-container>

<ng-template #tableTemplate let-ctx="ctx">
  <mat-table
    [dataSource]="ctx.dataSource"
    class="dino-main-table"
    matSort
    multiTemplateDataRows
    cdkDropList
    cdkDropListOrientation="horizontal"
    (cdkDropListDropped)="drop($event)"
  >
    <!-- Checkbox Column -->
    <ng-container matColumnDef="select" sticky>
      <ng-container>
        <mat-header-cell
          *matHeaderCellDef
          [ngClass]="isAggregationList ? 'dino-aggregation' : null"
        >
          <ng-container *ngIf="bulkActions">
            <mat-checkbox
              class="dino-row-actions"
              (change)="$event ? masterToggle() : null"
              [checked]="selection.hasValue() && isAllSelected()"
              [indeterminate]="selection.hasValue() && !isAllSelected()"
              [aria-label]="checkboxLabel()"
            >
            </mat-checkbox>
            <button
              *ngIf="bulkActionsAvailable?.includes('delete')"
              class="dino-bulk-delete-button"
              (click)="actionOnItems(selection.selected, {actionType: 'delete', matIcon: 'delete', askConfirm: true}, ctx.isDetails)"
              [disabled]="selection.selected.length <= 0"
              [attr.aria-label]="'Delete all items'|transloco"
            >
              <mat-icon aria-hidden="false" [attr.aria-label]="'delete icon'|transloco"
                >delete</mat-icon
              >
            </button>
            <button
              *ngIf="bulkActionsAvailable?.includes('deleteWithCheck')"
              class="dino-bulk-delete-button"
              (click)="actionOnItemsDeleteWithCheck(selection.selected, ctx.isDetails)"
              [disabled]="selection.selected.length <= 0"
              [attr.aria-label]="'Delete all items'|transloco"
            >
              <mat-icon aria-hidden="false" [attr.aria-label]="'delete icon'|transloco"
                >delete</mat-icon
              >
            </button>
            <button
              *ngIf="bulkActionsAvailable?.includes('bulkFormEdit')"
              class="dino-bulk-edit-button"
              (click)="actionOnItems(selection.selected, {actionType: 'bulkFormEdit', matIcon: 'edit', askConfirm: false}, ctx.isDetails)"
              [disabled]="selection.selected.length <= 0"
              [attr.aria-label]="'Edit all items'|transloco"
            >
              <mat-icon aria-hidden="false" [attr.aria-label]="'edit icon'|transloco"
                >edit_note</mat-icon
              >
            </button>
          </ng-container>
        </mat-header-cell>
        <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row" [ngClass]="isAggregationList ? 'dino-aggregation' : null">
          <mat-checkbox
            *ngIf="bulkActions"
            class="dino-row-actions"
            (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
            (change)="$event ? selection.toggle(row) : null"
            [checked]="selection.isSelected(row)"
            [aria-label]="checkboxLabel(row)"
          >
          </mat-checkbox>
          <mat-icon
            color="warn"
            class="dino-invalid-form-icon"
            *ngIf="row.data && (row.data['dinoinvalid'] === true || row.data['$invalid'] === true)"
            [matTooltip]="'This form might not be valid. Please review and fill its data'|transloco"
            [matTooltipPosition]="'right'"
            >warning</mat-icon
          >

          <ng-container *ngIf="row.data && row.data['dino_filestoupload'] === true">
            <mat-spinner
              *ngIf="isUploadingFilesRow(row); else uploadFilesIcon"
              diameter="20"
              class="dino-upload-files-spinner"
            ></mat-spinner>
            <ng-template #uploadFilesIcon>
              <mat-icon
                color="accent"
                class="dino-upload-files-icon"
                [class.dino-upload-files-icon--offline]="!isOnline"
                [matTooltip]="'Some files were stored locally due to a temporary network problem. Click to sync these files.'|transloco"
                [matTooltipPosition]="'right'"
                (click)="isOnline && $event.stopPropagation(); isOnline && uploadFilesRow(row)"
                >cloud_upload</mat-icon
              >
            </ng-template>
          </ng-container>
        </mat-cell>
      </ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Row Item Columns -->
    <ng-container
      *ngFor="let header of ctx.headers|async;"
      [matColumnDef]="header.column.toString()"
    >
      <ng-container *ngIf="header.sortable; else notSortable">
        <mat-header-cell cdkDrag *matHeaderCellDef [mat-sort-header]="header.column">
          <ng-container
            *ngTemplateOutlet="cellTemplatesMap[header.label] ?
        cellTemplatesMap[header.label] : defaultHeaderCellTemplate;
        context: {$implicit: header.label|transloco}"
          >
          </ng-container>
        </mat-header-cell>
      </ng-container>

      <ng-template #notSortable>
        <mat-header-cell cdkDrag *matHeaderCellDef>
          <ng-container
            *ngTemplateOutlet="cellTemplatesMap[header.label] ?
        cellTemplatesMap[header.label] : defaultHeaderCellTemplate;"
          >
          </ng-container>
        </mat-header-cell>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template #defaultHeaderCellTemplate>
        {{ header.label|transloco }}
        <mat-icon class="dino-header-icon" *ngIf="header.icon && (breakpointObserver.large|async)"
          >{{header.icon}}</mat-icon
        ></ng-template
      >

      <mat-cell *matCellDef="let element;">
        <ng-container
          *ngTemplateOutlet="header.populateWith ?
          externalRefCellTemplate :
          (header.repeatingSlideColumn ?
          repeatingCellTemplate :
          singleCellTemplate);"
        >
        </ng-container>
        <ng-template #externalRefCellTemplate>
          <ng-container *ngIf="(element[getRef(header)])|async as elemRef">
            <ng-container *ngIf="getPopulatedRef( elemRef, header.populateWith) as elem">
              <ng-container *ngIf="elem|dinoListCellIsStorageImageUrl; else defaultExternalRef">
                <mat-icon (click)="previewImage($event, elem)" class="dino-file-cell-icon"
                  >photo_camera</mat-icon
                ></ng-container
              >

              <ng-template #defaultExternalRef>
                <span [ngStyle]="{'color': getPopulatedRef( elemRef, 'color') ?? 'inherit'}"
                  >{{ elem|dinoDateValue }}</span
                ></ng-template
              >
            </ng-container>
          </ng-container>
          <mat-icon
            class="dino-edit-status-icon"
            [ngClass]="bds.isTouch()  ? 'dino-edit-status-icon-touch' : null"
            [tourAnchor]="uiServiceConfig ? 'edit-status-icon' : ''"
            *ngIf="
            (hasAllowedStatus(element)|async) === true &&
            header.column === 'form_status_ref_id' &&
            header.isEditable &&
            header.isEditable(element) &&
            header.editMethod &&
            element.data &&
            element.data['dinoinvalid'] !== true &&
            element.data['$invalid'] !== true"
            mat-list-icon
            (click)="$event.stopPropagation();header.editMethod(element);"
            >edit_note
          </mat-icon>
          <mat-progress-bar
            *ngIf="header.column === 'form_status_ref_id' && element.form_status_ref_id !== null && showStatusProgressBar"
            class="dino-status-bar"
            mode="determinate"
            [value]="getStatusProgress(element.form_status)|async"
          ></mat-progress-bar>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template #repeatingCellTemplate>
          <mat-tab-group #tabGroup [attr.tabgroupid]="header.repeatingSlideName + '_' + element.id">
            <mat-tab
              *ngFor="let item of getRepeatingSlideCellContent(element.data, header, dataSource?.choices); let idx = index;"
            >
              <mat-icon
                *ngIf="idx > 0"
                class="dino-repeating-slide-icon"
                (click)="moveRepeatingSlideTab(tabGroup, idx-1); $event.stopPropagation();"
                >navigate_before</mat-icon
              >

              <dino-list-cell
                [item]="item|dinoDateValue"
                [rowElement]="element"
                [header]="header"
                [previewMethod]="previewImage"
                [dialog]="dialog"
              />

              <mat-icon
                *ngIf="idx + 1 < getRepeatingSlideTabCount(tabGroup)"
                class="dino-repeating-slide-icon"
                (click)="moveRepeatingSlideTab(tabGroup, idx+1); $event.stopPropagation();"
                >navigate_next</mat-icon
              >
            </mat-tab>
          </mat-tab-group>
        </ng-template>

        <ng-template #singleCellTemplate
          ><mat-icon *ngIf="header.column === 'text' && element.icon !== null"
            >{{element.icon}}</mat-icon
          >
          <mat-icon *ngIf="header.column === 'text' && element.redirect_url!== null">link</mat-icon>

          <dino-list-cell
            [item]="element|dinoListCellValue:header:dataSource?.choices"
            [rowElement]="element"
            [header]="header"
            [previewMethod]="previewImage"
            [dialog]="dialog"
            (click)="$event.stopPropagation();"
            (booleanChangedEvt)="editQuickAction($event)"
          />
        </ng-template>
      </mat-cell>
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Actions Column -->
    <ng-container matColumnDef="actions" class="right" stickyEnd>
      <mat-header-cell cdkDrag *matHeaderCellDef class="dino-row-actions dino-header-row-actions">
        <div class="dino-columns-sel-btn-container">
          <button
            class="dino-columns-sel-btn"
            [matTooltip]="'Customize the columns'|transloco"
            [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
            #columns_btn
            color="accent"
            aria-label="Customize table columns"
            *ngIf="ctx.showColumnsSelector !== false"
            (click)="openColumnsSelectorDialog()"
            mat-fab
          >
            <mat-icon mat-list-icon> view_week </mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
      </mat-header-cell>
      <mat-cell *matCellDef="let row" class="dino-row-actions">
        <div class="dino-row-actions-container">
          <ng-container *ngIf="ctx.listRowActions|async|dinoAsListCellActions as actions">
            <ng-container *ngFor="let action of getMainActions(actions); let idx = index;">
                <mat-icon
                  class="dino-action-icon"
                  [ngStyle]="{'--position': idx}"
                  mat-list-icon
                  (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); actionOnItems(row, action, ctx.isDetails);"
                  >{{action.matIcon}}
                </mat-icon>
            </ng-container>

            <ng-container>
              <mat-icon
                mat-list-icon
                (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); toggleSecondaryIcons(); openActionsDialog(row, actions ,ctx.isDetails);"
                >more_horiz
              </mat-icon>
            </ng-container>
          </ng-container>
        </div>
      </mat-cell>
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Expanded Content Column - The detail row is made up of this one column that spans across all columns -->
    <ng-container matColumnDef="expandedDetail">
      <mat-cell
        *matCellDef="let row;"
        [attr.colspan]="ctx.displayedColumns.value.length"
        [@detailExpand]="isRowExpanded(row)"
        class="dino-expanded-cell"
      >
        <div class="dino-inner-table-container" *ngIf="isRowExpanded(row) && !ctx.isDetails">
          <ng-container *ngIf="expandedRowsData[row.id]?.data?.length">
            <mat-form-field
              class="dino-details-search"
              floatLabel="always"
              (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
            >
              <input
                matInput
                (keyup)="detailsKeywordsFilter($event, expandedRowsData[row.id])"
                [placeholder]="'search by keyword'"
              />
              <mat-icon color="primary" matSuffix>search</mat-icon>
            </mat-form-field>
            <ng-container
              *ngTemplateOutlet="tableTemplate; context: {ctx: {
                            showCheckBox: detailsListContext?.showCheckBox,
                            showPaginator: detailsListContext?.showPaginator,
                            showColumnsSelector: detailsListContext?.showColumnsSelector,
                            dataSource: expandedRowsData[row.id],
                            headers: detailsListContext?.headers,
                            displayedColumns: detailsListContext?.displayedColumns,
                            listRowActions: detailsListContext?.listRowActions,
                            isDetails: true
                        }}"
            >
            </ng-container>
          </ng-container>
        </div>
      </mat-cell>
    </ng-container>

    <mat-header-row *matHeaderRowDef="(ctx.displayedColumns|async)"></mat-header-row>

    <mat-row
      *matRowDef="let row; columns: (ctx.displayedColumns|async);"
      [class.dino-highlighted-row]="(breakpointObserver.extrasmall|async) ? isRowExpanded(row) : selection.isSelected(row)"
      [class.dino-highlighted-light]="isHighlightedRow(row)"
      [class.dino-expanded-row]="isRowExpanded(row)"
      [class.dino-details-row]="ctx.isDetails"
      (click)="rowToggle(row)"
      (mouseenter)="onRowMouseEnter($event, row)"
      (mouseleave)="onRowMouseLeave($event)"
    >
    </mat-row>

    <ng-container *ngIf="expandable">
      <mat-row
        *matRowDef="let row; columns: ['expandedDetail']"
        class="dino-row-details"
        [class.dino-highlighted-row]="selection.isSelected(row)"
        [class.dino-details-row]="ctx.isDetails"
      >
      </mat-row>
    </ng-container>
  </mat-table>
</ng-template>

<div class="dino-table-container" [ngClass]="bds.isTouch() ? 'dino-table-container-touch' : null">
  <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="tableTemplate; context: {ctx: mainListContext}"></ng-container>
</div>
```

```scss
      display: none;
    }
    .mat-mdc-icon-button.dino-expand-all-button {
      margin-left: 17px;
    }
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    .mat-column-select {
      min-width: 5px;
    }
    .dino-row-actions {
      .dino-columns-sel-btn {
        visibility: visible;
      }
    }
    .dino-expanded-row-actions {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      .dino-row-action-box {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }
    .dino-select-item-checkbox {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  @-moz-keyframes spinClockWise {
    0% {
      -moz-transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
      -moz-transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  @-webkit-keyframes spinClockWise {
    0% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  @keyframes spinClockWise {
    0% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
      transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  .isLightTheme .mat-mdc-header-cell:first-of-type,
  .isLightTheme .mat-mdc-cell:first-of-type {
    background-color: var(--mat-sidenav-content-background-color);
  }
  .isDarkTheme .mat-mdc-header-cell:first-of-type,
  .isDarkTheme .mat-mdc-cell:first-of-type {
    background-color: var(--mat-sidenav-content-background-color);
  }
}

.mat-mdc-select-panel {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  padding: 0px 0px !important;
}

.isDarkTheme .dino-list-toolbar .dino-list-count {
  color: rgba(var(--mat-sidenav-content-text-color)) !important;
}

.isDarkTheme .dino-hover .mat-mdc-cell:not(.mat-mdc-cell:last-of-type.mat-column-actions) {
  background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(300);
  .dino-row-actions-container {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(300);
  }
}
.isLightTheme .dino-hover .mat-mdc-cell:not(.mat-mdc-cell:last-of-type.mat-column-actions) {
  background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(300);
  .dino-row-actions-container {
    background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(300);
  }
}
.isDarkTheme .mat-mdc-header-row {
  background: var(--mat-sidenav-content-background-color) !important;
}
.isLightTheme .mat-mdc-header-row {
  background: var(--mat-sidenav-content-background-color) !important;
}
```

## File: list/list.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/list` module provides a Selection List component, its List Datasource and its Column Selector.
This is built upon the material "mat-table" component and the "MatTableDataSource" class, and extends the core List class in the 
`@dino/core/list` module.

The Selection List component is a sortable and filterable generic Table, with selection and bulk/individual action functionalities.
A sorting, a paginator and filtering components can be associated to it.
It allows the deletion, editing and inspection of the element rows.

The List Data Source provides the actual data to the Selection List, by generating queries and forwarding them to the Data Model Manager relative
to list Model.
It takes a string of query parameters from the FiltersService, when filters are present, and generates a Mango Query from it.

The Colums Selector is a dialog component associated with the Selection List. Its purpose is to allow the choice of which columns to display
in the table.
```

```html
            <mat-error> {{showValErrors(loginForm.get('email'), 'Email')}} </mat-error>

            <mat-error> {{showValErrors(loginForm.get('password'), 'Password')}} </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>
          <div *ngIf="loginError.error === true" class="dino-error-message">
            {{loginError.message ? (loginError.message|transloco) : 'Incorrect email and/or password'|transloco}}
          </div>
          <button
            mat-fab
            type="submit"
            color="accent"
            aria-label="submit"
            (click)="login()"
            [disabled]="processing || (loginDisabled|async) === true"
          >
            <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
          </button>
          <mat-progress-bar
            aria-label="Login progress"
            [class.dino-show]="processing === true"
            [color]="'accent'"
            mode="indeterminate"
          >
          </mat-progress-bar>
        </form>

        <div *ngIf="externalAuthAvailable">
          <dino-login-oauth [externalOAuthProviders]="externalAuthAvailable" [nhost]="nhost"></dino-login-oauth>
        </div>

        <button class="dino-login-action-btn" *ngIf="signupAvailable" mat-button color="primary" (click)="toggleSignupForm(true)">
          {{'New User? Create new account'|transloco}}
        </button>
        <button
          class="dino-login-action-btn"
          *ngIf="resetPassAvailable"
          mat-button
          color="primary"
          (click)="toggleResetPassForm(true)"
        >
          {{'Forgot your password?'|transloco}}
        </button>
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  </div>
  <ng-content select="[additionalContent]"></ng-content>
</div>
```

```scss
        max-height: 30vh;

        .dino-logo {
          flex: 1 0 auto;
          margin: 3em auto;

          img {
            max-width: 220px;
            margin: auto;
          }
        }
      }

      &.dino-login-form-container {
        form {
          mat-form-field {
            display: block;
            .mat-mdc-form-field-wrapper {
              padding-bottom: 0px;
            }
          }
          input {
            display: block;
            background-color: transparent;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            line-height: 2.5em;
            margin: 0 auto 1.1em;
            border: none;
            text-align: center;

            &:focus {
              outline: 0;
            }
          }

          .dino-error-message {
            display: none;
          }

          &.dino-error {
            .dino-error-message {
              display: block;
              font-size: 1.1em;
              line-height: 2.5em;
              color: rgba(91, 91, 96, 0.87);
            }
          }
          mat-progress-bar {
            margin-top: 1em;
            opacity: 0;

            &.dino-show {
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  .dino-login-action-btn {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    margin: auto;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .dino-policy-field {
    .dino-policy-text {
      margin-top: 15px;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      overflow-y: scroll;
      max-height: 100px;
      max-width: 35vw;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
        max-width: 90vw;
      }
      text-align: start;
    }
    .dino-policy-checkbox-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      justify-content: space-around;
      max-width: 35vw;
      @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
        max-width: 90vw;
      }
      .dino-policy-checkbox-label,
      .dino-policy-checkbox-input {
        input {
          position: relative;
          top: 5px;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```html
<mat-toolbar
  *ngIf="sidenav && (showNav|async) !== false"
  class="dino-toolbar"
  [class.dino-shadowed]="(!sidenav.opened) || (breakpointObserver.large|async)"
>
  <button
    mat-icon-button
    (click)="menuToggle()"
    aria-label="Toggle menu button"
    *ngIf="(sideMenuDisabled|async) !== true"
  >
    <mat-icon
      *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.large|async) ? (extendedSidenav|async) : sidenav.opened;else closed_menu"
      >menu_open</mat-icon
    >
  </button>

  <ng-template #closed_menu><mat-icon>menu</mat-icon></ng-template>

  <img class="dino-toolbar-logo" [src]="logoImagePath" alt="logo" />

  <div class="dino-toolbar-actions">
    <span
      *ngIf="(newVersionReady|async) as newVersion"
      class="dino-new-version-button"
      aria-label="Toolbar action"
      [matTooltip]="('New App version ready!'|transloco) + ' - ' + newVersion"
      [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
      (click)="refreshVersion()"
      color="warn"
    >
      <mat-icon color="accent">download_for_offline</mat-icon>
    </span>

    <ng-container *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) !== true">
      <ng-container *ngIf="(availableTokens|async) !== null">
        <div
          class="dino-tokens-counter"
          [matTooltip]="'Your DINO-AI Credits'|transloco"
          [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
          (click)="openUserArea('tokens')"
        >
          <mat-icon
            aria-hidden="false"
            aria-label="DINO-AI Credits"
            class="dino-tokens-counter-icon"
            [matBadge]="availableTokens|async"
            matBadgeColor="primary"
            >smart_toy</mat-icon
          >
        </div>
      </ng-container>
      <mat-icon
        aria-hidden="false"
        aria-label="Light mode"
        style="opacity: 0.5"
        (click)="openUserArea('theme')"
        >wb_sunny</mat-icon
      >
      <mat-slide-toggle
        [checked]="ts.isDark()"
        (change)="setDarkTheme($event.checked)"
        style="margin: 10px"
        aria-label="Toggle Dino Theme"
      >
      </mat-slide-toggle>
      <mat-icon
        aria-hidden="false"
        aria-label="Dark mode"
        style="opacity: 0.5; margin-right: 25px;"
        (click)="openUserArea('theme')"
        >nights_stay</mat-icon
      >
    </ng-container>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) !== true">
      <ng-container *ngIf="(linkIcons|async) as actionLinkIcons">
        <ng-container *ngFor="let linkIcon of actionLinkIcons">
          <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="linkIcon.url ? linkIconTemplate : infoIconTemplate ">
          </ng-container>
          <ng-template #linkIconTemplate>
            <a
              [href]="linkIcon.url"
              target="_blank"
              class="dino-link-button"
              aria-label="Toolbar action"
              [matTooltip]="linkIcon.tooltip || ''"
              [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
            >
              <mat-icon color="primary">{{linkIcon.icon}}</mat-icon>
            </a>
          </ng-template>
          <ng-template #infoIconTemplate>
            <span
              class="dino-link-button"
              aria-label="Toolbar action"
              [matTooltip]="linkIcon.tooltip || ''"
              [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
              onclick=""
            >
              <mat-icon color="primary">{{linkIcon.icon}}</mat-icon>
            </span>
          </ng-template>
        </ng-container>
      </ng-container>
    </ng-container>
    <mat-icon class="dino-user-settings" (click)="openUserArea()">settings</mat-icon>
    <ng-template #syncOnline>
      <ng-container *ngIf="!syncIcon; else svgSyncIconTemplate;">
        <mat-icon
          *ngIf="(syncSpinnerDisabled|async) !== true"
          class="dino-sync-detector"
          [matTooltip]="(isThereUnsyncedData|async) === true && (isSyncing|async) === false ? ('You have unsynced data. Please click the Sync icon.'|transloco) : ''"
          [ngClass]="[(isSyncing|async) ? 'dino-sync-active' : '', (isThereUnsyncedData|async) === true && (isSyncing|async) === false ? 'dino-sync-unsynced':'']"
          [matBadge]="'!'"
          matBadgeColor="warn"
          [matBadgeHidden]="(problemSyncing|async) !== true || (isSyncing|async) === true"
          (click)="runSync()"
          >{{(isThereUnsyncedData|async) === true && (isSyncing|async) === false ?
          'sync_problem':'sync'}}</mat-icon
        >
      </ng-container>
      <ng-template #svgSyncIconTemplate>
        <mat-icon
          *ngIf="(syncSpinnerDisabled|async) !== true"
          class="dino-sync-detector"
          [ngClass]="(isSyncing|async) ? 'dino-sync-active' : ''"
          (click)="runSync()"
          svgIcon="{{syncIcon}}"
          >sync</mat-icon
        >
      </ng-template>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template #syncOffline>
      <mat-icon class="dino-sync-detector">sync_disabled</mat-icon>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-container
      *ngIf="!isBackendless"
      [ngTemplateOutlet]="(networkStatusService.isOnline$|async) ? syncOnline : syncOffline "
    >
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container>
      <mat-icon
        *ngIf="unreadNotificationsNumber|async as newNotifications; else noBadgeTemplate"
        [matMenuTriggerFor]="notificationsmenu"
        class="dino-notifications-icon"
        [matBadge]="newNotifications"
        matBadgeColor="primary"
        [@.disabled]="newNotifications <= 0"
        [@notificationRing]="notificationRingState ? 'a' : 'b'"
      >
        notifications
      </mat-icon>

      <ng-template #noBadgeTemplate>
        <mat-icon [matMenuTriggerFor]="notificationsmenu" class="dino-notifications-icon">
          notifications
        </mat-icon>
      </ng-template>

      <mat-menu #notificationsmenu="matMenu" [class]="'dino-notifications-menu'">
        <div class="dino-notifications-menu-container">
          <div
            class="dino-notification-container"
            *ngFor="let notification of lastNotifications|async;"
          >
            <button
              [ngClass]="notification.read ? 'dino-read-notification' : 'dino-unread-notification'"
              (click)="notification.read ? null : markNotificationAsRead($event, notification)"
              [matTooltip]="notification.text || ''"
              [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
              [matTooltipShowDelay]="1000"
              mat-menu-item
            >
              <mat-icon class="dino-notification-icon"> {{notification.icon}} </mat-icon>
              {{notification.text}}

              <button
                *ngIf="notification.redirect_url"
                class="dino-notification-gotourl-btn"
                mat-mini-fab
                color="accent"
                [matTooltip]="'Go to url'|transloco"
                [matTooltipPosition]="'left'"
                [matTooltipShowDelay]="500"
                (click)="goToNotificationUrl($event, notification)"
              >
                <mat-icon>link</mat-icon>
              </button>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <ng-container *ngIf="lastUnreadNotifications|async as unreadNotifications">
          <button
            *ngIf="unreadNotifications > 0"
            mat-menu-item
            class="dino-notification-action-button"
            (click)="markAllAsRead($event)"
          >
            {{'Mark all as read'|transloco}}
          </button>
        </ng-container>

        <button mat-menu-item class="dino-notification-action-button" (click)="goToNotifications()">
          {{'View all notifications'|transloco}}
        </button>
      </mat-menu>
    </ng-container>

    <dino-lang-selector [customLanguages]="customLanguages"></dino-lang-selector>
    <ng-container *ngIf="userDisplayName|async as userDisplayName">
      <mat-icon
        class="dino-active-user-icon"
        color="primary"
        (click)="openUserArea()"
        *ngIf="!userSectionIcon; else svgIconTemplate"
        >person</mat-icon
      >
      <ng-template #svgIconTemplate>
        <mat-icon
          class="dino-active-user-icon"
          color="primary"
          (click)="openUserArea()"
          svgIcon="{{userSectionIcon ?? ''}}"
        ></mat-icon>
      </ng-template>

      <span class="dino-active-user-text" (click)="openUserArea()">{{userDisplayName}}</span>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-container *ngIf="(logoutDisabled|async) !== true">
      <mat-icon
        class="dino-logout-button"
        [ngClass]="(logoutOff|async) ? 'dino-logout-button-off' : ''"
        (click)="logout()"
        >logout</mat-icon
      >
    </ng-container>
  </div>
</mat-toolbar>

<mat-sidenav-container class="dino-sidenav-container" autosize>
  <mat-sidenav
    *ngIf="(showNav|async) !== false"
    #sidenav
    [mode]="(breakpointObserver.large|async) ? 'side' : 'over'"
    [opened]="breakpointObserver.large|async"
    class="dino-sidenav"
    [class.dino-large-sidenav]="breakpointObserver.large|async"
    [class.extended]="extendedSidenav|async"
  >
    <mat-nav-list
      *ngIf="(isLoading|async) === false && (sideMenuDisabled|async) !== true"
      [@loadComponent]
      ><div *ngFor="let section of sections$|async" [tourAnchor]="section.url+'-nav'">
        <a
          mat-list-item
          [disableRipple]="true"
          [attr.aria-label]="section.label|transloco"
          [class.dino-section-selected]="isSectionSelected(section)"
          [routerLink]="[section.url]"
          (click)="menuClick()"
          aria-label="Section"
        >
          <mat-icon *ngIf="!section.svgIcon; else svgIconTemplate">{{section.icon}}</mat-icon>
          <ng-template #svgIconTemplate>
            <mat-icon svgIcon="{{section.svgIcon ?? ''}}"></mat-icon>
          </ng-template>
          <span *ngIf="extendedSidenav|async">{{section.label|transloco}}</span>
        </a>
      </div>
      <ng-container *ngIf="adminSections$|async as adminSections">
        <ng-container *ngIf="adminSections.length > 0 && (isAdmin|async)">
          <mat-divider></mat-divider>
          <mat-divider></mat-divider>
          <a
            mat-list-item
            [disableRipple]="true"
            *ngFor="let adminSection of adminSections"
            [attr.aria-label]="adminSection.label"
            [class.dino-section-selected]="isSectionSelected(adminSection)"
            [routerLink]="[adminSection.url]"
            (click)="menuClick()"
            aria-label="Admin Section"
          >
            <mat-icon *ngIf="!adminSection.svgIcon; else svgAdminIconTemplate"
              >{{adminSection.icon}}</mat-icon
            >
            <ng-template #svgAdminIconTemplate>
              <mat-icon svgIcon="{{adminSection.svgIcon ?? ''}}"></mat-icon>
            </ng-template>
            <span *ngIf="extendedSidenav|async">{{adminSection.label|transloco}}</span>
          </a>
        </ng-container>
      </ng-container>

      <a
        *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.large|async) === false"
        class="dino-extend-menu-button"
        mat-list-item
        [attr.aria-label]="(extendedSidenav|async) ? 'close' : 'open'"
        [disableRipple]="true"
        (click)="extendedSidenav.next(!extendedSidenav.getValue())"
        aria-label="Expand menu"
      >
        <mat-icon>{{(extendedSidenav|async) ? 'close_fullscreen' : 'open_in_full' }}</mat-icon>
      </a>
    </mat-nav-list>
  </mat-sidenav>

  <mat-sidenav-content
    [ngClass]="'dino-sidenav-content '+(tourService.isTourOngoing.value ? 'dino-sidenav-content-not-scrollable' : '')"
    [@loadComponent]
  >
    <ng-container *ngIf="(isLoading|async) === false; else loading">
      <router-outlet [@loadComponent] (activate)="onRouterOutletLoading($event)"></router-outlet>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-template #loading>
      <div class="dino-loading" [@loadComponent]>
        <ng-container *ngIf="spinnerImagePath; else defaultspinner">
          <h2 [@loadComponent] class="dino-sync-text">{{"Initializing data"|transloco}}...</h2>
          <dino-loading-spinner
            [@loadComponent]
            [spinnerImagePath]="spinnerImagePath"
          ></dino-loading-spinner>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-template #defaultspinner>
          <h2 [@loadComponent] class="dino-sync-text">{{"Initializing data"|transloco}}...</h2>
          <mat-spinner
            [@loadComponent]
            class="dino-component-load-spinner"
            mode="indeterminate"
            [diameter]="180"
          ></mat-spinner
        ></ng-template>
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  </mat-sidenav-content>
</mat-sidenav-container>
```
