```scss
@use 'angular-material-css-vars' as mat-css-vars;

dino-main-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;

  .mat-drawer {
    &.mat-drawer-side.mat-sidenav,
    &.mat-drawer-push.mat-sidenav,
    &.mat-drawer-over.mat-sidenav {
      .mat-mdc-list-item {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        transition: all ease 0.5s;
        &:hover,
        &.dino-section-selected {
          background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(100);
          color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
          box-shadow: 3px 0px 0px 0px mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500) inset;
        }
        &:hover {
          opacity: 0.6;
        }
        &.dino-section-selected {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .mat-drawer-side.mat-sidenav {
    border-right: none;
    .mat-nav-list,
    .mat-mdc-list-base {
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .mat-mdc-list-item {
      padding: 6px;
    }
  }

  .mat-sidenav.dino-sidenav {
    top: 56px;
  }

  .dino-toolbar {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 10;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    font-size: 14px;

    &.dino-shadowed {
      box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) inset;
      animation-name: shadowed-toolbar;
      animation-duration: 2s;
      animation-direction: alternate-reverse;
      animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
    }

    .dino-toolbar-logo {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 10vw;
      max-height: 80%;
      margin: auto 10px;
    }
    .dino-logout-button {
      transition: opacity ease-in-out 0.5s;
      &.dino-logout-button-off {
        opacity: 0.3;
      }
    }
    .dino-toolbar-actions {
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      align-content: stretch;
      align-items: center;
      .mat-icon {
        flex: 1 0 auto;
      }
      .dino-tokens-counter {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        flex: 1 0 auto;
        margin-right: 20px;
        .dino-tokens-counter-icon {
          margin-right: 4px;
        }
        .dino-tokens-counter-amount {
          color: var(--mat-badge-text-color);
          background: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
          border-radius: 50%;
          width: 22px;
          height: 22px;
          padding: 2px;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          font-weight: bold;
          &.add {
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
            transform: scale(1);
            animation: pulse_primary 4s ease-in-out;
          }
          &.remove {
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);
            transform: scale(1);
            animation: pulse_accent 4s ease-in-out;
          }
        }
      }
      .dino-link-button {
        margin-right: 25px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-content: center;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .dino-user-settings {
        margin-right: 10px;
        opacity: 0.3;
        @media only screen and (min-width: 768px) {
          display: none;
        }
      }
      .dino-sync-detector,
      .dino-notifications-icon {
        margin-right: 25px;
        @media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
          margin-right: 10px;
        }
        &.dino-sync-active {
          -webkit-animation: spin 2s ease-in-out infinite;
          -moz-animation: spin 2s ease-in-out infinite;
          animation: spin 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        &.dino-sync-unsynced {
          color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500);
        }
      }
      .dino-notifications-icon {
        -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 4px;
        -moz-transform-origin: 50% 4px;
        transform-origin: 50% 4px;
      }
      .dino-active-user-icon {
        color: inherit;
        margin-right: 5px;
      }
      .dino-active-user-text {
        margin-right: 20px;
        font-size: 90%;
      }
      .dino-active-user-icon,
      .dino-active-user-text {
        opacity: 0.3;
        @media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
          display: none;
        }
      }
    }

    .dino-new-version-button {
      margin-right: 25px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-content: center;
      text-decoration: none;
      animation: pulse_accent 5s infinite;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
  }

  .mat-sidenav-container.dino-sidenav-container {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .mat-sidenav-content.dino-sidenav-content {
    top: 65px;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    height: 100vh;
    padding: 5px;
    background-color: inherit;
    .dino-loading {
      position: fixed;
      width: 50%;
      left: 25%;
      .dino-sync-text {
        opacity: 0.3;
        text-align: center;
        margin: auto;
        position: relative;
        top: 10em;
        color: inherit;
      }
      .dino-component-load-spinner {
        margin: auto;
        margin-top: 30vh;
      }
    }
    &.dino-sidenav-content-not-scrollable {
      overflow-y: hidden;
      height: 100% !important;
    }
  }
  @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
    .mat-sidenav-content.dino-sidenav-content:has(ajf-form) {
      height: 85vh;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
  }

  .mat-sidenav.dino-large-sidenav {
    box-shadow: 1px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    animation-name: shadowed-sidenav;
    animation-duration: 2s;
    animation-direction: alternate-reverse;
    animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
  }

  .mat-mdc-nav-list {
    padding-top: 0px;
    width: auto;
    .mat-mdc-list-item {
      min-height: 60px;
      &:focus,
      &:hover {
        background-color: inherit;
      }
      span {
        padding: 10px;
      }
      .mat-mdc-list-item-unscoped-content {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
      }
    }
    &.mat-mdc-list-base {
      padding-top: 0px;
    }
    .dino-extend-menu-button {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 75px;
    }
  }
}
.dino-notifications-menu,
.mat-mdc-menu-content {
  &:empty {
    display: none;
  }
  &.mat-mdc-menu-panel {
    min-height: unset !important;
    max-width: 460px;
    @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
      max-width: 280px;
    }
  }
}
.dino-notifications-menu .mat-mdc-menu-content {
  padding-bottom: 0px !important;
  padding-top: 0px !important;

  .dino-notifications-menu-container {
    max-height: 240px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0px;
    position: relative;
    .dino-notification-container {
      display: flex;
      .dino-notification-gotourl-btn {
        top: 2px;
        max-width: 30px;
        max-height: 30px;
        .mat-icon {
          position: relative;
          min-width: 40px;
          margin: auto;
        }
      }
      .mdc-list-item__primary-text {
        white-space: nowrap !important;
      }
    }
  }

  .mat-mdc-menu-item {
    .dino-notification-icon {
      color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500);
      min-width: 24px;
    }
    &.dino-unread-notification {
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500, 0.2);
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    &.dino-notification-action-button {
      span {
        text-align: center;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        width: 100%;
      }
      border-top: 1px solid mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500, 0.4);
      background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-warn(500, 0.2);
      -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 1.3s;
      transition: all ease-in-out 1.3;
      &:hover {
        background-color: mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-warn(500, 0.4);
      }
    }
  }
}

@keyframes shadowed-toolbar {
  from {
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) inset;
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: none;
  }
}

@keyframes shadowed-sidenav {
  from {
    box-shadow: 1px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: none;
  }
}

@-moz-keyframes spin {
  0% {
    -moz-transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
  100% {
    -moz-transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
}
@-webkit-keyframes spin {
  0% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
  100% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
}
@keyframes spin {
  0% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
  100% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
}
@keyframes pulse_accent {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500, 0.5);
  }

  70% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500, 0);
  }

  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-accent(500, 0);
  }
}
@keyframes pulse_primary {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500, 0.9);
  }

  70% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500, 0);
  }

  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 mat-css-vars.mat-css-color-primary(500, 0);
  }
}
```

```html
<div class="dino-metric-editor-container">
  <p class="dino-metric-editor-title" mat-dialog-title>
    {{data.metricAction|transloco}} {{metricName|transloco}}
  </p>
  <mat-dialog-content>
    <form *ngIf="metricForm" [formGroup]="metricForm" autocomplete="off">
      <ng-container *ngFor="let field of metricFormFields; let idx = index">
        <ng-container *ngIf="!field.fieldName.includes('file'); else imageField">
          <mat-form-field class="dino-metric-editor-field" appearance="fill">
            <ng-template #autocompleteField>
              <input
                matInput
                [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
                [placeholder]="field.placeholder ?? ''"
                [matAutocomplete]="auto"
                [readonly]="data.metricAction === 'View'"
                value="{{field.value}}"
              />
              <mat-autocomplete
                #auto="matAutocomplete"
                [autoActiveFirstOption]="true"
                [displayWith]="displayParentName"
              >
                <mat-option *ngFor="let option of parentOptions | async" [value]="option">
                  {{option.parent_name}}
                </mat-option>
              </mat-autocomplete>
            </ng-template>
            <ng-template #regularField>
              <input
                matInput
                [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
                [placeholder]="field.placeholder ?? ''"
                [readonly]="data.metricAction === 'View'"
                value="{{field.value}}"
              />
            </ng-template>
            <ng-template #dateField>
              <input
                matInput
                [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
                [placeholder]="field.placeholder ?? ''"
                [readonly]="data.metricAction === 'View'"
                [matDatepicker]="picker"
                value="{{field.value}}"
              />
              <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="picker"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
              <mat-datepicker #picker></mat-datepicker>
            </ng-template>
            <ng-template #fileField>
              <input
                type="hidden"
                matInput
                [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
                [readonly]="true"
                value="{{field.value}}"
              />
            </ng-template>
            <ng-container
              *ngTemplateOutlet="field.fieldName === 'parent' ? autocompleteField : field.fieldName.includes('date') ? dateField : field.fieldName.includes('file') ? fileField : regularField"
            ></ng-container>
            <mat-error *ngIf="metricForm.controls[field.fieldName].hasError('required')">
              Please enter a {{field.fieldName}}
            </mat-error>

            <mat-error *ngIf="metricForm.controls[field.fieldName].hasError('incorrect')">
              Please select a valid parent
            </mat-error>

            <mat-hint [class.dino-warning]="metricForm.controls[field.fieldName].warning"
              >{{ metricForm.controls[field.fieldName].warning ?
              (metricForm.controls[field.fieldName].warning|transloco) :
              field.hint|transloco}}</mat-hint
            >
          </mat-form-field>
        </ng-container>
        <ng-template #imageField>
          <div class="dino-metric-image-field">
            <ng-container *ngIf="preview || field.value">
              <div class="dino-metric-image-preview">
                <p class="dino-metric-image-preview-title">{{'Image preview'|transloco}}</p>
                <img alt="" class="dino-metric-image" [src]="preview || field.value" />
              </div>
            </ng-container>
            <ng-container *ngIf="data.metricAction !== 'View'">
              <mat-tab-group
                class="dino-metric-image-tab-group"
                (selectedTabChange)="imageCaptureComponent.reset()"
              >
                <mat-tab>
                  <ng-template mat-tab-label>
                    <mat-icon>upload_file</mat-icon>
                  </ng-template>
                  <div class="dino-metric-image-upload">
                    <div class="dino-metric-image-tab-title">
                      {{'Upload a jpg or png file'|transloco}}
                    </div>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      id="metricFileInput"
                      accept=".jpg,.jpeg,.png"
                      (change)="onMetricFileSelected($event)"
                      style="visibility: hidden; height: 1px"
                    /><br />
                    <label for="metricFileInput">
                      <a color="primary" mat-raised-button>{{'Choose file'|transloco}}</a>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </mat-tab>
                <mat-tab>
                  <ng-template mat-tab-label>
                    <mat-icon>add_a_photo</mat-icon>
                  </ng-template>
                  <dino-image-capture
                    #imageCaptureComponent
                    (capturedImageEvt)="snapshotPreview($event)"
                  ></dino-image-capture>
                </mat-tab>
              </mat-tab-group>
            </ng-container>
          </div>
        </ng-template>
      </ng-container>
    </form>
    <ng-container
      *ngIf="data.metricAction !== 'View' || (data.metricAction === 'View' && attributes().controls.length)"
    >
      <mat-divider></mat-divider>
      <br />
      <form [formGroup]="metricDataForm" autocomplete="off">
        <p mat-dialog-title class="dino-additional-attributes-title">
          {{'Additional attributes'|transloco}}
        </p>
        <div formArrayName="attributes" class="dino-additional-attributes-container">
          <ng-container *ngFor="let dataField of attributes().controls; let idx = index">
            <div class="dino-additional-attribute-entry" [formGroupName]="idx">
              <mat-form-field class="dino-metric-editor-field" appearance="fill">
                <mat-label>{{'Attribute name'|transloco}}</mat-label>
                <input
                  matInput
                  [formControlName]="'attribute_name'"
                  [placeholder]="('Attribute name'|transloco)"
                  [readonly]="data.metricAction === 'View'"
                  [value]="dataField.value['attribute_name']"
                />
              </mat-form-field>
              <mat-form-field class="dino-metric-editor-field" appearance="fill">
                <mat-label>{{'Attribute value'|transloco}}</mat-label>
                <input
                  matInput
                  [formControlName]="'attribute_value'"
                  [placeholder]="('Attribute value'|transloco)"
                  [readonly]="data.metricAction === 'View'"
                  [value]="dataField.value['attribute_value']"
              /></mat-form-field>
              <button
                *ngIf="data.metricAction !== 'View'"
                class="dino-attribute-button dino-remove-attribute-button"
                aria-label="Remove attribute"
                (click)="removeAttribute(idx)"
                mat-mini-fab
              >
                <mat-icon class="icon">remove</mat-icon>
              </button>
            </div>
          </ng-container>
          <button
            *ngIf="data.metricAction !== 'View'"
            class="dino-attribute-button"
            aria-label="Add attribute"
            (click)="addAttribute()"
            mat-mini-fab
          >
            <mat-icon class="icon">add</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </ng-container>
  </mat-dialog-content>
  <div mat-dialog-actions>
    <button mat-raised-button color="warn" (click)="closeEditor()">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
    <button
      *ngIf="data.metricAction !== 'View'"
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      cdkFocusInitial
      (click)="saveMetric()"
      [disabled]="!isFormValid()"
    >
      {{'Save'|transloco}}
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```html
          <label for="excelFileInput">

        </div>
        <mat-checkbox formControlName="reuseMetricName">
          {{'Don\'t import metrics if name exists'|transloco}}
```

```scss
dino-metric-import {
  .mat-mdc-card {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    border-left: none;

      width: 100%;
      font-size: 14px !important;
    }

    .mat-mdc-card-content {
      form {
        display: flex;
        flex-flow: column wrap;
        justify-content: center;
        .dino-upload-container {
          width: 600px;
          flex: 1 0 auto;
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          align-items: center;
          input {
            flex: 0 1 10%;
          }
          label {
            flex: 0 1 35%;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            a {
              flex: 1 0 auto;
            }
          }
          .file-name {
            white-space: nowrap;
          }
          @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
            justify-content: center;
            width: 90%;
          }
        }
      }
      .dino-upload-respose {
        margin-top: 5px;
        white-space: pre-line;
      }
    }
    .mat-mdc-card-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-flow: row wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background-color: transparent !important;
      .mat-mdc-raised-button {
        transition: all ease-in-out 0.3;
        -webkit-transition: all ease-in-out 0.3s;
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Represents a generic Item in a Drag & Drop list.
 */
export interface MixedEditorItem {
  /**
   * The Item displayed name
   */
  itemName: string;

  /**
   * The Item collection name
   */
  itemType: string;

  /**
   * The Item UUID
   */
  itemId: string;

  /**
   * The icon type of the Item
   */
  itemIcon: string;

  /**
   * If true, only one Item of such type can be added to
   * the saveList
   */
  uniqueItem: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, the Item represents the inclusion of all options
   * of its category
   */
  allOptionItem: boolean;

  /**
   * If true, the Item is displayed in the list
   */
  displayed: boolean;

  /**
   * The ID of the Item parent
   */
  itemParentId: string | null;

  /**
   * If true, the item can't be added or removed.
   */
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## File: mixed-editor/src/mixed-editor.html
```html
<div class="dino-mixed-editor-container">
  <div class="dino-mixed-list-input">
    <div class="dino-mixed-list-savename">
      <mat-form-field appearance="fill">
        <mat-label>{{'Group name'|transloco}}</mat-label>
        <input #saveListName matInput [disabled]="viewOnly" (input)="onSaveNameInput()" />
        <mat-icon matSuffix>badge</mat-icon>
      </mat-form-field>
    </div>
    <div class="dino-mixed-list-filter">
      <mat-form-field appearance="fill">
        <mat-label>{{('Search available items'|transloco)}}</mat-label>
        <input #search matInput />
        <mat-icon matSuffix>rule</mat-icon>
      </mat-form-field>
    </div>
  </div>

  <ng-container *ngIf="sourceList | async as sourceListByType">

    <mat-tab-group>
      <mat-tab *ngFor="let itemsType of mixedItemTypes | async; trackBy: trackByType"
        [label]="itemsType.label|transloco">

        <!-- Lazy-render tab content only when the tab is active -->
        <ng-template matTabContent>
          <div class="dino-mixed-list-container-both">
            <div class="dino-mixed-list-container">
              <p class="dino-mixed-editor-side-title">{{'Group items'|transloco}}</p>
              <cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport itemSize="68" class="dino-mixed-list">
                <div class="dino-mixed-list-item dino-mixed-list-item-savelist"
                  *cdkVirtualFor="let item of saveList[itemsType.type]; trackBy: trackById">
                  <mat-icon class="dino-mixed-list-icon-identifier" [matTooltip]="tooltipCache.get(item.itemId) ?? ''"
                    [matTooltipPosition]="'after'">{{item.itemIcon}}</mat-icon>
                  <div class="dino-mixed-list-entry-tile">{{item.itemName}}</div>
                  <button *ngIf="!viewOnly" mat-icon-button color="primary" aria-label="Remove item"
                    (click)="removeItem(item)">
                    <mat-icon>delete</mat-icon>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport>
            </div>

            <div [class]="'dino-mixed-list-container' + (viewOnly ? ' dino-mixed-list-container-hidden' : '')">
              <p class="dino-mixed-editor-side-title">{{'Available items'|transloco}}</p>
              <cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport itemSize="68" class="dino-mixed-list">
                <div class="dino-mixed-list-item"
                  *cdkVirtualFor="let item of (filteredSourceList$ | async)?.[itemsType.type]; trackBy: trackById"
                  [class.dino-mixed-list-item-disabled]="item.disabled"
                  [class.dino-mixed-list-item-alloption]="item.allOptionItem">
                  <mat-icon class="dino-mixed-list-icon-identifier" [matTooltip]="tooltipCache.get(item.itemId) ?? ''"
                    [matTooltipPosition]="'after'">{{item.itemIcon}}</mat-icon>
                  <div class="dino-mixed-list-entry-tile">{{item.itemName}}</div>

                  <ng-template #boxBtn>
                    <button mat-icon-button color="primary" aria-label="Add item" (click)="addItem(item, true)">
                      <mat-icon>add</mat-icon>
                    </button>
                  </ng-template>

                  <ng-template #boxDisabledBtn>
                    <button mat-icon-button color="primary" aria-label="Disabled item">
                      <mat-icon>not_interested</mat-icon>
                    </button>
                  </ng-template>

                  <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="item.disabled ? boxDisabledBtn : boxBtn"></ng-container>
                </div>
              </cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport>
            </div>
          </div>
        </ng-template>

      </mat-tab>
    </mat-tab-group>

  </ng-container>

  <div class="dino-mixed-list-action-buttons-container">
    <button *ngIf="!viewOnly" mat-raised-button class="dino-mixed-list-action-button" color="primary" cdkFocusInitial
      (click)="saveMixedList()" [disabled]="!isSaveValid">
      {{'Save'|transloco}}
    </button>
    <button mat-raised-button class="dino-mixed-list-action-button" color="warn" (click)="onClose()">
      {{'Close'|transloco}}
    </button>
  </div>

</div>
```

```scss
.dino-mixed-editor-container {
  min-width: 50vw;
  max-height: 80vh;
  overflow-y: scroll;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  padding: 0px 15px;

  .dino-mixed-editor-side-title {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 110%;
  }
}

.dino-mixed-editor-title {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.dino-mixed-list-container-both {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px;
  width: inherit;
}

.dino-mixed-list-container {
  margin: auto;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  width: 45%;
  padding: 10px;
}

.dino-mixed-list-action-buttons-container {
  margin: auto;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  max-width: 60vw;
  @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
    max-width: 90vw;
  }
  text-align: center;
}

.dino-mixed-list-container-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.dino-mixed-list-action-buttons-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  .dino-mixed-list-action-button {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    padding: 5px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    &:not(:last-child) {
      margin-right: 15px;
    }
  }
}

.dino-mixed-list-input {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.dino-mixed-list-filter,
.dino-mixed-list-savename {
  margin-top: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  width: 45%;
  .mat-mdc-form-field {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

.dino-mixed-list-icon-identifier {
  margin-right: auto;
  font-size: 24px !important;
}

.dino-mixed-list-entry-tile {
  margin-right: auto;
}

.dino-mixed-list {
  margin: auto;
  min-width: 10vw;
  border: solid 1px #ccc;
  border-radius: 4px;
  flex: 1 0 auto;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 22.4vh;
  overflow: hidden;

  cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport {
    height: 100%;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }
}

.dino-mixed-list-item,
.dino-mixed-list-item-disabled {
  padding: 10px 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-transform: capitalize;
  &:last-child {
    border: none;
  }
}

.dino-mixed-list-item-disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dino-mixed-list-item-alloption {
  background-color: rgba(50, 219, 100, 0.1);
}
```

## File: pipeline-stepper/src/pipeline-stepper.html
```html
<mat-horizontal-stepper
  class="dino-pipeline-stepper"
  [ngClass]="(isPipeline|async) && (currentFormStatus|async) !== null? '' : 'dino-pipeline-stepper-viewonly'"
  #stepper
  [linear]="(isPipeline|async) === false"
  [disableRipple]="true"
  [selectedIndex]="(selectedIndex|async) ?? 0"
>
  <ng-template matStepperIcon="done">
    <mat-icon>done</mat-icon>
  </ng-template>
  <ng-template matStepperIcon="edit-writable">
    <mat-icon>edit</mat-icon>
  </ng-template>
  <ng-template matStepperIcon="locked">
    <mat-icon>lock</mat-icon>
  </ng-template>
  <ng-template matStepperIcon="edit">
    <mat-icon>edit</mat-icon>
  </ng-template>

  <mat-step
    *ngFor="let step of steps|async; let idx = index;"
    [label]="step.timeStamp ?  'completed on ' + (step.timeStamp|date:'short') + ' '+ step.label : step.label"
    [completed]="(getStepState(step)|async) === 'done'"
    [state]="(getStepState(step)|async) ?? 'edit-readonly'"
    [editable]="step.editable"
    [aria-labelledby]="(getStepState(step)|async) ?? ''"
  >
  </mat-step>
</mat-horizontal-stepper>
```

## File: reset-password/src/reset-password.html
```html
<div>
  <div class="dino-logo-container">
    <div class="dino-logo">
      <img [src]="logoImagePath" alt="" />
    </div>
  </div>
  <ng-container *ngIf="(invalidTicket|async) === false; else invalidTicketTemplate;">
    <ng-container *ngIf="(passChanged|async) === false ; else passChangedTemplate;">
      <div class="dino-login-form-container">
        <form
          class="dino-change-pass-form"
          [class.dino-error]="changePassForm"
          [formGroup]="changePassForm"
        >
          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>New Password</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              aria-label="New Password"
              [placeholder]="'New Password'|transloco"
            />
            <mat-error>
              {{showValErrors(changePassForm.get('password'), 'New Password')}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>Confirm New Password</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="confirm_password"
              name="confirm_password"
              type="password"
              aria-label="Confirm New Password"
              [placeholder]="'Confirm New Password'|transloco"
            />
            <mat-error>
              {{showValErrors(changePassForm.get('confirm_password'), 'Confirm New Password')}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>
          <div *ngIf="changePassError.error === true" class="dino-error-message">
            {{changePassError.message ? (changePassError.message|transloco) : 'Incorrect password'|transloco}}
          </div>
          <button
            class="dino-reset-action-btn"
            mat-fab
            type="submit"
            color="accent"
            aria-label="submit"
            [disabled]="processing || (changePassDisabled|async) === true"
            (click)="changePassword()"
          >
            <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </form>
        <br />
      </div>
    </ng-container>
  </ng-container>
</div>

<ng-template #invalidTicketTemplate>
  <div class="dino-reset-pass-text">
    <h1>
      <mat-icon>sentiment_very_dissatisfied</mat-icon><br>
      {{'Your Reset Password ticket is invalid or expired. Please try again.'|transloco}}
    </h1>
  </div>
</ng-template
>
<ng-template #passChangedTemplate>
  <h1><mat-icon>done</mat-icon><br />{{'Password changed'|transloco}}!</h1></ng-template
>
```

```scss
dino-reset-password {

      flex: 1 0 auto;

        align-items: center;

          flex: 1 0 auto;
          margin: 3em auto;

          img {
            max-width: 33vw;
            margin: auto;
          }
        }
      }

      &.dino-login-form-container {
        form {
          mat-form-field {
            display: block;
            .mat-mdc-form-field-wrapper {
              padding-bottom: 0px;
            }
          }
          input {
            display: block;
            background-color: transparent;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            line-height: 2.5em;
            margin: 0 auto 1.1em;
            border: none;
            text-align: center;

            &:focus {
              outline: 0;
            }
          }

          .dino-error-message {
            display: none;
          }

          &.dino-error {
            .dino-error-message {
              display: block;
              font-size: 1.1em;
              line-height: 2.5em;
              color: rgba(91, 91, 96, 0.87);

          }
          mat-progress-bar {
            margin-top: 1em;
            opacity: 0;

            &.dino-show {
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
          .dino-reset-action-btn {
            margin-top: 20px;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

    font-size: 3em;

}
```

```html
<ng-template #keywordfilter>
  <ng-container [formGroup]="textSearchFilters">
    <mat-form-field
      class="dino-filter-keyword"
      floatLabel="always"
      (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
      (keydown.Space)="$event.stopImmediatePropagation();"
    >
      <input
        matInput
        #keywordinput
        formControlName="keyword"
        [placeholder]="'search by keyword'|transloco"
      />
      <mat-icon color="primary" matSuffix>search</mat-icon>
      <mat-icon
        matSuffix
        color="primary"
        *ngIf="keywordinput.value"
        aria-label="Clear"
        (click)="clearFilter('keyword', textSearchFilters)"
        class="dino-clear-filter-button"
        >close</mat-icon
      >
    </mat-form-field>
  </ng-container>
</ng-template>

<ng-template #filtersbar>
  <div class="dino-filters-bar">
    <dino-search-filters-preset-manager
      *ngIf="presetManager && (breakpointObserver.small|async|isFalseOrNull)"
    ></dino-search-filters-preset-manager>

    <ng-container [formGroup]="dateSearchFilters">
      <mat-form-field floatLabel="always">
        <input
          #datestartinput
          matInput
          formControlName="dateStart"
          [matDatepicker]="pickerFrom"
          [matDatepickerFilter]="maxDatePicker"
          [placeholder]="'From date'|transloco"
        />
        <mat-datepicker-toggle matSuffix [for]="pickerFrom"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
        <mat-icon
          matSuffix
          color="primary"
          *ngIf="datestartinput.value"
          aria-label="Clear"
          (click)="clearFilter('dateStart', dateSearchFilters)"
          class="dino-clear-filter-button"
          >close</mat-icon
        >
        <mat-datepicker #pickerFrom></mat-datepicker>
      </mat-form-field>

      <mat-form-field floatLabel="always">
        <input
          #dateendinput
          matInput
          formControlName="dateEnd"
          [matDatepicker]="pickerTo"
          [matDatepickerFilter]="minDatePicker"
          [placeholder]="'To date'|transloco"
        />
        <mat-datepicker-toggle color="primary" matSuffix [for]="pickerTo"></mat-datepicker-toggle>
        <mat-icon
          matSuffix
          color="primary"
          *ngIf="dateendinput.value"
          aria-label="Clear"
          (click)="clearFilter('dateEnd', dateSearchFilters)"
          class="dino-clear-filter-button"
          >close</mat-icon
        >
        <mat-datepicker #pickerTo></mat-datepicker>
      </mat-form-field>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container *ngFor="let group of additionalBasicFilters; let idx = index" [formGroup]="group">
      <ng-template #metricOrStatusField>
        <mat-form-field
          floatLabel="always"
          *ngIf="additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx] &&
          (isMetric(group) ||
          isMetricSubFilter(group) ||
          isUser(group) ||
          isUserGroup(group) ||
          (isStatus(group) && (availableFormStatuses|async)?.length) )"
          (click)="showOptions(group)"
        >
          <input
            matInput
            #fltinput
            [formControlName]="additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]"
            placeholder="{{((additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]).charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
              (additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]).slice(1).replace('_', ' ').replace('data', '')).trim()|transloco}}"
            [matAutocomplete]="auto"
          />
          <mat-icon matSuffix color="primary">search</mat-icon>

          <mat-icon
            matSuffix
            color="primary"
            *ngIf="fltinput.value"
            aria-label="Clear"
            (click)="clearFilter(additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx], group)"
            class="dino-clear-filter-button"
            >close</mat-icon
          >

          <mat-autocomplete
            #auto="matAutocomplete"
            [autoActiveFirstOption]="false"
            [displayWith]="displayItemName"
            (optionSelected)="optionClicked($event.option.value, additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx], group)"
          >
            <ng-container *ngIf="isMetric(group); else statusOptions ">
              <mat-option
                *ngFor="let option of metricFiltersOptions[getControlKey(group)] | async"
                [value]="option"
                [ngClass]="'dino-option-level-' + (option.level ?? '0')"
              >
                <mat-checkbox [checked]="option.selected" 
                  (change)="toggleSelection(option, additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx], group)" 
                  (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
                  {{displayItemName({id: [option.id], name: option.name, secondary:
                    getMetricDataSecondaryAttribute(option, secondaryMetricFieldsDisplayed,
                    additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx])})}}
                </mat-checkbox>
              </mat-option>
            </ng-container>

            <ng-template #statusOptions>
              <ng-container *ngIf="isStatus(group); else metricSubFilterOptions">
                <mat-option
                  [ngStyle]="{'color': option.color ?? 'inherit'}"
                  *ngFor="let option of formStatusFilterOptions | async"
                  [value]="option"
                >
                  {{option.label}}
                </mat-option>
              </ng-container>

              <ng-template #metricSubFilterOptions>
                <ng-container *ngIf="isMetricSubFilter(group); else userFilterOptions">
                  <mat-option
                    *ngFor="let option of metricFiltersOptions[getControlKey(group)] | async"
                    [value]="option"
                    [ngClass]="'dino-option-level-' + (option.level ?? '0')"
                  >
                    {{option[getMetricSubFilter(option, group)]}}
                  </mat-option>
                </ng-container>

                <ng-template #userFilterOptions>
                  <ng-container *ngIf="isUser(group); else userGroupFilterOptions">
                    <mat-option *ngFor="let option of usersFilterOptions | async" [value]="option">
                      {{option.full_name}}
                    </mat-option>
                  </ng-container>

                  <ng-template #userGroupFilterOptions>
                    <ng-container *ngIf="isUserGroup(group)">
                      <mat-option *ngFor="let option of userGroupsFilterOptions | async" [value]="option">
                        {{option.groupName}}
                      </mat-option>
                    </ng-container>
                  </ng-template>
                </ng-template>
              </ng-template>
            </ng-template>
          </mat-autocomplete>
        </mat-form-field>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template #default>
        <mat-form-field floatLabel="always" *ngIf="additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]">
          <input
            matInput
            [formControlName]="additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]"
            placeholder="{{'search by'|transloco}} {{additionalBasicFiltersLabels[idx]|transloco}}"
          />
          <mat-icon matSuffix color="primary">search</mat-icon>
        </mat-form-field>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-container
        *ngTemplateOutlet="isMetric(group) || isStatus(group) || isMetricSubFilter(group) || isUser(group) || isUserGroup(group) ? metricOrStatusField : default"
      ></ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container *ngIf="generatedAdditionalFilters|async as genFilters">
      <ng-container *ngIf="additionalFilters && genFilters && genFilters.length">
        <button
          class="dino-filters-dialog-button"
          mat-stroked-button
          (click)="openDialog()"
          [attr.aria-label]="'Open the advanced filters'|transloco"
        >
          <mat-icon color="primary" matSuffix>filter_list</mat-icon>
        </button>
      </ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container *ngIf="exportable">
      <button
        class="dino-export-button"
        mat-stroked-button
        (click)="openExportDialog()"
        [attr.aria-label]="'Export items'|transloco"
      >
        <mat-icon color="primary" matSuffix>cloud_download</mat-icon>
      </button>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container *ngIf="displayFormMapButton|async">
      <button
        class="dino-form-map-button"
        mat-stroked-button
        (click)="viewMap(); $event.stopPropagation();"
        [attr.aria-label]="'Show Map'|transloco"
      >
        <mat-icon color="primary" matSuffix>place</mat-icon>
      </button>
    </ng-container>
  </div>
</ng-template>

<dino-search-filters-chips
  (excludeFilter)="removeFilter($event, ['additional'])"
  [chipsType]="'additional'"
>
</dino-search-filters-chips>
```

```scss
dino-search-filters-bar {
  .mat-icon {
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .mat-line {
    cursor: default !important;
  }

  .dino-filters-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row wrap;
    .mat-mdc-form-field {
      padding-right: 5px;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      height: 65px;
      .mat-mdc-form-field-icon-suffix > .mat-icon {
        padding: 4px;
      }
      @media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
        padding: 0px;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        margin: auto;
      }
    }
    .dino-filters-dialog-button,
    .dino-form-map-button,
    .dino-export-button {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      height: 44px;
      margin-right: 5px;
      .mat-icon {
        margin-left: 0px;
        margin-right: 0px;
        margin: auto;
      }
    }

    .mat-mdc-icon-button {
      align-self: center;
    }
  }

  .dino-open-aggregation-filters {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 0 auto;
  }
  /* TODO(mdc-migration): The following rule targets internal classes of autocomplete that may no longer apply for the MDC version. */
  .mat-autocomplete-panel {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .mat-expansion-panel,
  .mat-expansion-panel:not(.mat-expanded):not([aria-disabled='true'])
    .mat-expansion-panel-header:hover {
    background: inherit;
    background: transparent !important;
  }
  .mat-expansion-panel {
    .mat-expansion-panel-content .mat-expansion-panel-body {
      padding-right: 27px;
    }
    padding: 5px;
    .mat-mdc-form-field.dino-filter-keyword {
      flex: 1 0 auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      height: 60px;
      border-top-left-radius: 10px;
      border-top-right-radius: 10px;
      .mat-mdc-input-element,
      .mat-icon {
        position: relative;
        bottom: 8px;
      }
    }

    .mat-expansion-indicator {
      position: relative;
      left: 3px;
    }
    @media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
      .mat-expansion-indicator {
        left: 10px;
      }
      .mat-expansion-indicator::after {
        padding: 6px;
        margin-left: 10px;
      }
    }
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    .dino-filters-dialog-button,
    .dino-form-map-button,
    .dino-export-button {
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      width: 100%;
    }
  }
}

.mat-mdc-autocomplete-panel {
  @for $i from 0 through 9 {
    $margin: 0.6em * $i;
    .dino-option-level-#{$i} {
      margin-left: $margin;
      opacity: calc(1 / ($i + 1)) + 0.3;
      &:before {
        @if ($i > 0) {
          content: '\276F';
          font-size: 75%;
          margin-right: 10px;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  mat-option .mat-pseudo-checkbox {
    display: none !important;
  }
}
```

## File: search-filters-bar/search-filters-bar.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/search-filters-bar` module provides a main filtering component that can be associated to a Selection List
ad it's usually displayed as a toolbar on top of it.
It displays the default basic filters, inherited from `@dino/core/list` SearchFiltersComponent, and allows the setting and displaying of 
additional basic filters.

When additional filters generated from the "data" attribute of the List model are present, it displays a button for opening a secondary
filtering component (usually a Dialog) containing the additional filters.
```

## File: search-filters-chips/search-filters-chips.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/search-filters-chips` module provides a component that displays all the currently active filters of a Selection List,
in the form of individual "chips".
Each chip can be deleted, thus removing the correspondent filter.
The chips can be associated with a specific list of filters (basic, additional, temporary), or they can represent all the active filters.
```

```html
<div class="dino-filters-dialog-menu">
  <button mat-raised-button (click)="search()" color="accent">{{'Search'|transloco}}</button>
  <mat-button-toggle-group
    [formControl]="logicAndOrToggle"
    name="fontStyle"
    aria-label="Font Style"
  >
    <mat-button-toggle
      value="and"
      [disabled]="(fts.canSwitchLogic()|async) === false"
      [checked]="true"
      >{{'All'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle
    >
    <mat-button-toggle value="or">{{'Any'|transloco}}</mat-button-toggle>
  </mat-button-toggle-group>
  <button mat-raised-button (click)="closeDialog()" color="warn">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
  <dino-search-filters-chips
    (excludeFilter)="removeFilter($event, 'temporary')"
    [chipsType]="'temporary'"
  >
  </dino-search-filters-chips>
</div>

<mat-dialog-content>
  <mat-tab-group (selectedIndexChange)="setCurrentGroupId($event)">
    <mat-tab
      *ngFor=" let filterGroup of fts.generatedFilters|async;"
      [label]="filterGroup.filterGroupName|transloco"
      style="width: 100%"
    >
      <ng-template matTabContent>
        <dino-search-filters-widget
          *ngFor="let filterItem of filterItemsData|async;"
          [filterItemData]="filterItem"
          (addFilter)="addFilter($event, 'temporary')"
        >
        </dino-search-filters-widget>
      </ng-template>
    </mat-tab>
  </mat-tab-group>
</mat-dialog-content>
```

```scss
}
```

## File: search-filters-dialog/search-filters-dialog.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/search-filters-dialog` module provides a Dialog component containing all the non-basic (additional) filters, each displayed as
an individual widget, associated with a Selection List and a main filtering component (such as `@dino/material/search-filters-bar` SearchFiltersBar).

The dialog content is a "mat-tab" component that identifies each group of filters with a single tab.
Each tab contains all the filters of its group, displayed as Widgets.

All the filters added, removed or modified in the Dialog, are stored in a temporary list of filters.
They are applied to the Selection List by clicking on the "Search" button.
```

## File: search-filters-preset-manager/search-filters-preset-manager.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/search-filters-preset-manager` module provides a Preset Manager component, that takes care of loading and saving presets
of Filters, as encoded strings of query parameters.
It is associated with a main filtering component, and communicates with it via the `@dino/core/list` FiltersService.

It retrieves and saves presets in the browser LocalStorage, showing the ones available as options in a "mat-autocomplete" component.
```

## File: search-filters-widget/src/search-filters-widget.html
```html
<ng-container *ngIf="formGroup|async as fg">
  <form novalidate [formGroup]="fg">
    <div class="ajf-form-container">
      <ng-container *ngIf="(slides|async) as curSlides">
        <ng-container *ngFor="let slideInstance of curSlides; trackBy:trackNodeById">
          <ng-container *ngIf="!(slideInstance|ajfIsRepeatingSlideInstance)">
            <div class="ajf-form-page">
              <mat-card appearance="outlined" class="mat-elevation-z4">
                <div class="elem">
                  <ng-template
                    ngFor
                    let-fieldInstance
                    [ngForOf]="slideInstance.flatNodes"
                    [ngForTrackBy]="trackNodeById"
                  >
                    <mat-card-header>
                      <mat-card-title>
                        {{
                        (fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.description?(fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.description:
                        ' ' |transloco }}
                      </mat-card-title>
                    </mat-card-header>
                    <mat-card-content>
                      <i
                        [class]="(fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.fieldType | ajfFieldIcon"
                        item-right
                      ></i>
                      <label
                        class="dino-filter-widget-label"
                        *ngIf="(fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.fieldType !== ajfFieldTypes.Empty"
                        [innerHTML]="(fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.label|transloco"
                      ></label>
                      <ajf-field
                        [instance]="(fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance)"
                        [readonly]="readonly"
                      ></ajf-field>
                      <ng-container
                        *ngIf="conditionOperatorByFieldType((fieldInstance|ajfAsFieldInstance).node.fieldType) as operators"
                      >
                        <ng-container *ngIf="operators.length > 0">
                          <mat-button-toggle-group
                            #group
                            *ngIf="(fieldInstance.node|asFilterItem).operator as operator"
                            (change)="changeOperator($event)"
                            [value]="operator ? operator.label : null "
                          >
                            <mat-button-toggle
                              *ngFor="let operator of operators"
                              [value]="operator"
                              [checked]="operatorValue.getValue().value === operator.value"
                            >
                              {{ operator.label|transloco }}
                            </mat-button-toggle>
                          </mat-button-toggle-group>
                        </ng-container>
                      </ng-container>
                    </mat-card-content>
                  </ng-template>
                </div>
                <mat-card-actions>
                  <button
                    class="dino-create-filter-button"
                    [disabled]="(isCreateFilterButtonDisabled|async) !== false && !isNoValueOperator()"
                    mat-raised-button
                    (click)="createFilter()"
                    color="accent"
                  >
                    {{'Create Filter'|transloco}}<mat-icon>add</mat-icon>
                  </button>
                </mat-card-actions>
              </mat-card>
            </div>
          </ng-container>
        </ng-container>
      </ng-container>
    </div>
  </form>
</ng-container>
```

## File: search-filters-widget/search-filters-widget.md
```markdown
The `@dino/material/search-filters-widget` module provides a Widget component, consisting of a single field AjfForm, representing a single filter.
The content of the Widget is based on the type of the filter (text, numerical, single or multiple choice etc.).
If comparison operators are needed, they are displayed in a "mat-button-toggle-group".

Each single Widget and its corresponding filter can be activated or deactivated, and is automatically hidden or disabled if the filter
visibility or validation conditions are not met.
```

```html
      <mat-card-header>
        <mat-card-title class="dino-checkout-landing-title"
          >{{'Purchase complete!'|transloco}}<mat-icon
            class="dino-checkout-landing-icon dino-checkout-landing-icon-success"
            >check</mat-icon
          ></mat-card-title
        >
        <mat-card-subtitle class="dino-checkout-landing-title"
          >{{status.metadata?.product_name}} : {{status.metadata?.quantity}}</mat-card-subtitle
        >
        <mat-card-subtitle class="dino-checkout-landing-title"
          >{{'Total paid'|transloco}} : {{parseTotal(status.total)}}</mat-card-subtitle
        >
      </mat-card-header>
      <ng-container *ngIf="(availableTokens|async) !== null">
        <mat-card-content>
          {{'You now have'|transloco}}: <span class="dino-tokens-amount">{{availableTokens|async}}</span> credits
        </mat-card-content>
      </ng-container>
    </mat-card>
  </div>
</ng-container>
```

```scss
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }
}
```

## File: user-area/src/user-area.html
```html
<ng-container *ngIf="userData|async as userInfo">
  <div class="dino-user-area-header">
    <h1 class="dino-user-area-title" mat-dialog-title>
      User Area - {{userInfo.full_name}} - {{userInfo.email}}
    </h1>

    <div class="dino-user-area-dark-mode-toggle" *ngIf="(breakpointObserver.small|async) === true">
      <mat-icon aria-hidden="false" aria-label="Light mode" style="opacity: 0.5">wb_sunny</mat-icon>
      <mat-slide-toggle
        [checked]="themeService.isDark()"
        (change)="setDarkTheme($event.checked)"
        style="margin: 10px"
        aria-label="Toggle Dino Theme"
      >
      </mat-slide-toggle>
      <mat-icon aria-hidden="false" aria-label="Dark mode" style="opacity: 0.5;"
        >nights_stay</mat-icon
      >
    </div>
  </div>

  <mat-dialog-content>
    <mat-accordion>
      <!-- PASSWORD section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'password'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> {{'Change Password'|transloco}} </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <form
          class="dino-user-area-form"
          [class.dino-error]="changePassForm"
          [formGroup]="changePassForm"
        >
          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Current Password'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="current_password"
              name="current_password"
              type="password"
              aria-label="Current Password"
              [placeholder]="'Current Password'|transloco"
            />
            <mat-error>
              {{showValErrors(changePassForm.get('current_password'), 'Current Password')}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'New Password'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              aria-label="New Password"
              [placeholder]="'New Password'|transloco"
            />
            <mat-error>
              {{showValErrors(changePassForm.get('password'), 'New Password')}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>

          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>{{'Confirm New Password'|transloco}}</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="confirm_password"
              name="confirm_password"
              type="password"
              aria-label="Confirm New Password"
              [placeholder]="'Confirm New Password'|transloco"
            />
            <mat-error>
              {{showValErrors(changePassForm.get('confirm_password'), 'Confirm New Password')}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>
          <div *ngIf="changePassError.error === true" class="dino-error-message">
            {{changePassError.message ? (changePassError.message|transloco) : 'Incorrect password'|transloco}}
          </div>
          <button
            mat-icon-button
            type="submit"
            color="accent"
            aria-label="submit"
            [disabled]="(processing|async) || (changePassDisabled|async) === true"
            (click)="changePassword()"
          >
            <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
          </button>
        </form>
      </mat-expansion-panel>

      <!-- API KEY section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'apikeys'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> API Keys </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <form
          class="dino-user-area-form"
          [class.dino-error]="apiKeysForm"
          [formGroup]="apiKeysForm"
        >
          <mat-form-field>
            <mat-label>DINO-AI API Key</mat-label>
            <input
              matInput
              formControlName="pandino_api_key"
              name="pandino_api_key"
              [type]="hide_api_key ? 'password' : 'text'"
              aria-label="DINO-AI API Key"
              [placeholder]="'DINO-AI API Key'"
              [readonly]="(storedPandinoAPIKey|async) !== null"
            />
            <mat-icon matSuffix (click)="hide_api_key = !hide_api_key"
              >{{hide_api_key ? 'visibility' : 'visibility_off'}}</mat-icon
            >
            <mat-icon matSuffix [cdkCopyToClipboard]="apiKeysForm.get('pandino_api_key')!.value" (click)="copyToClipboard()"
              >content_copy</mat-icon
            >
            <mat-error *ngIf="apiKeysForm.get('pandino_api_key')?.hasError('required')">
              {{'API Key is'|transloco}} <strong>{{'required'|transloco}}</strong>
            </mat-error>
            <mat-error *ngIf="apiKeysForm.get('pandino_api_key')?.hasError('invalid')">
              {{'Invalid API Key'|transloco}}
            </mat-error>
          </mat-form-field>

          <div class="dino-api-key-button-container">
            <ng-container *ngIf="(storedPandinoAPIKey|async) === null; else keymatched">
              <button
                mat-icon-button
                type="submit"
                color="accent"
                aria-label="submit"
                [disabled]="(processing|async)"
                (click)="validateAPIKey(apiKeysForm.get('pandino_api_key')?.value)"
              >
                <mat-icon>arrow_forward</mat-icon>
              </button>
            </ng-container>

            <ng-template #keymatched>
              <button
                class="dino-matched-pandino-api-key-button"
                mat-icon-button
                aria-label="matched"
              >
                <mat-icon>check</mat-icon>
              </button></ng-template
            >
          </div>
        </form>
      </mat-expansion-panel>

      <!-- TOKENS and CREDITS section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel *ngIf="(availablePandinoTokens|async) !== null" [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'tokens'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> {{'Credits'|transloco}} </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <div
          class="dino-user-area-form"
        >
          <p>{{'DINO-AI Credits'|transloco}}</p>
          <div class="dino-tokens-counter-container">
            <mat-icon color="primary" class="dino-tokens-icon">smart_toy</mat-icon> <span class="dino-tokens-counter">{{(availablePandinoTokens|async)}}</span>
          </div>
          <button *ngIf="stripeConfig" mat-raised-button color="accent" (click)="openPayment()">{{'Add more'|transloco}}<mat-icon matSuffix>add</mat-icon></button>
        </div>
      </mat-expansion-panel>

      <!-- THEME section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'theme'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> DINO Theme </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <div class="dino-save-theme">
          <form
            class="dino-user-area-form"
            [class.dino-error]="changePassForm"
            [formGroup]="dinoSaveThemeForm"
          >
            <mat-form-field
              appearance="fill"
              [style.color]="primaryColor"
              [colorPicker]="themeService.currentThemeVal ? themeService.currentThemeVal.primary : primaryColor"
              (colorPickerChange)="setPrimaryColor($event)"
            >
              <input
                matInput
                readonly
                [formControlName]="'primary'"
                [placeholder]="'Primary Color'|transloco"
                [value]="primaryColor"
              />
              <mat-icon matSuffix>palette</mat-icon>
              <mat-hint>{{'Primary color' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
            </mat-form-field>

            <mat-form-field
              appearance="fill"
              [style.color]="accentColor"
              [colorPicker]="themeService.currentThemeVal ? themeService.currentThemeVal.accent : accentColor"
              (colorPickerChange)="setAccentColor($event)"
            >
              <input
                matInput
                readonly
                [formControlName]="'accent'"
                [placeholder]="'Accent Color'|transloco"
                [value]="accentColor"
              />
              <mat-icon matSuffix>palette</mat-icon>
              <mat-hint>{{'Accent color' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
            </mat-form-field>

            <mat-form-field
              appearance="fill"
              [style.color]="warningColor"
              [colorPicker]="themeService.currentThemeVal ? themeService.currentThemeVal.warning : warningColor"
              (colorPickerChange)="setWarningColor($event)"
            >
              <input
                matInput
                readonly
                [formControlName]="'warning'"
                [placeholder]="'Warning Color'|transloco"
                [value]="warningColor"
              />
              <mat-icon matSuffix>palette</mat-icon>
              <mat-hint>{{'Warning color' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
            </mat-form-field>

            <mat-form-field appearance="fill">
              <input
                matInput
                type="text"
                [formControlName]="'presetName'"
                [placeholder]="'Pick a preset name'|transloco"
                [matAutocomplete]="auto"
              />
              <mat-autocomplete #auto="matAutocomplete">
                <mat-option *ngFor="let option of themePresetOptions | async" [value]="option">
                  {{option|transloco}}
                </mat-option>
              </mat-autocomplete>
              <mat-hint>{{'Pick a preset name' | transloco}}</mat-hint>
            </mat-form-field>

            <div class="dino-theme-presets-button-container">
              <button
                class="dino-theme-presets-button"
                mat-raised-button
                color="accent"
                (click)="loadDinoTheme()"
                [disabled]="!dinoSaveThemeForm.get('presetName')?.valid"
                [attr.aria-label]="'Load the preset'|transloco"
              >
                {{'Load'|transloco}}
              </button>

              <button
                class="dino-theme-presets-button"
                mat-raised-button
                color="primary"
                (click)="saveDinoTheme()"
                [disabled]="!dinoSaveThemeForm.valid"
                [attr.aria-label]="'Save the preset'|transloco"
              >
                {{'Save'|transloco}}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </mat-expansion-panel>

      <!-- TOUR AND TUTORIAL section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel *ngIf="uiServiceConfig" [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'tutorial'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> {{'Tutorials'|transloco}} </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <div
          class="dino-user-area-form dino-user-area-form-centered"
        >
          <button mat-raised-button color="accent" (click)="startTutorial()">{{'Start Dino Tour'|transloco}}</button>
        </div>
      </mat-expansion-panel>

      <!-- BACKUP section -->
      <mat-expansion-panel *ngIf="backupRestore && (isAdmin|async)" [expanded]="expandedPanel === 'backup'">
        <mat-expansion-panel-header>
          <mat-panel-title> Backup and Restore </mat-panel-title>
        </mat-expansion-panel-header>
        <div class="dino-backup-restore-buttons-container">
          <ng-container *ngIf="(processing|async) === false; else loading">
            <label class="dino-backup-restore-button">
              <a
                [href]="dbDownloadUrl|async"
                [download]="'dino_db_export.json'"
                type="button"
                mat-raised-button
                color="primary"
              >
                {{'Backup Data'|transloco}}
              </a>
            </label>
            <input
              type="file"
              id="jsonFileInput"
              accept=".json"
              (change)="onJsonImportfileSelected($event)"
              style="visibility: hidden; height: 1px"
            />
            <label for="jsonFileInput" class="dino-backup-restore-button">
              <a color="accent" type="button" mat-raised-button>{{'Restore Data'|transloco}}</a>
            </label>
          </ng-container>
          <ng-template #loading>
            <div class="dino-loading">
              <div>{{'Restoring Data...'|transloco}}</div>
              <br /><br />
              <ng-container *ngIf="spinnerImagePath; else defaultspinner"
                ><dino-loading-spinner [spinnerImagePath]="spinnerImagePath"></dino-loading-spinner>
              </ng-container>
              <ng-template #defaultspinner
                ><mat-spinner class="dino-component-load-spinner" mode="indeterminate"></mat-spinner
              ></ng-template>
            </div>
          </ng-template>
        </div>
      </mat-expansion-panel>
    </mat-accordion>
  </mat-dialog-content>
  <div mat-dialog-actions class="dino-user-area-menu">
    <button mat-raised-button (click)="closeDialog()" color="warn">{{'Close'|transloco}}</button>
  </div>
</ng-container>
```

## File: user-editor/src/user-editor.html
```html
<div class="dino-user-editor-container">
  <h1 mat-dialog-title>{{data.userAction?.toUpperCase()}} USER</h1>
  <mat-dialog-content>
    <form *ngIf="userForm" [formGroup]="userForm" autocomplete="off">
      <ng-container *ngFor="let field of userFormFields; let idx = index">
        <mat-form-field class="dino-user-editor-field" appearance="fill">
          <input
            matInput
            [type]="field.inputType || 'text'"
            [formControlName]="field.fieldName"
            [placeholder]="field.placeholder || ''"
            [readonly]="data.userAction === 'view'"
            value="{{field.value}}"
          />

          <mat-error>
            {{showValErrors(userForm.get([field.fieldName]), field.placeholder)}}
          </mat-error>

          <mat-hint>{{field.hint}}</mat-hint>
        </mat-form-field>
      </ng-container>
      <mat-form-field class="dino-user-editor-field dino-user-editor-field-big" appearance="fill">
        <mat-label>User Permission Groups</mat-label>
        <mat-select
          formControlName="user_group_ids"
          multiple
          [disabled]="data.userAction === 'view'"
        >
          <mat-option
            *ngFor="let userGroup of userGroups|async"
            [value]="userGroup.id"
            [disabled]="data.userAction === 'view'"
          >
            {{userGroup.groupName}}
          </mat-option>
        </mat-select>
      </mat-form-field>
    </form></mat-dialog-content
  >
  <div mat-dialog-actions>
    <button mat-raised-button color="warn" (click)="closeEditor()">Close</button>
    <button
      *ngIf="data.userAction !== 'view'"
      mat-raised-button
      color="primary"
      cdkFocusInitial
      (click)="saveUser()"
      [disabled]="!isFormValid()"
    >
      Save
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```html
<h4 mat-dialog-title>{{'Confirm'|transloco}} {{data.action.actionType|transloco}}</h4>
<mat-dialog-content>
  <ng-container *ngIf="!data.customContent; else customContent">
    {{'Do you want to'|transloco}} {{data.action.actionType|transloco}} {{'the selected items'|transloco}} ?
  </ng-container>
  <ng-template #customContent> {{data.customContent}} </ng-template>
</mat-dialog-content>
<br />
<mat-dialog-actions align="center">
  <button
    class="dino-confirm-button"
    mat-raised-button
    color="primary"
    (click)="confirmationResponse(true)"
  >
    {{'Yes'|transloco}}
  </button>
  <button
    class="dino-cancel-button"
    mat-raised-button
    color="accent"
    (click)="confirmationResponse(false)"
  >
    {{'No'|transloco}}
  </button>
</mat-dialog-actions>
```
